https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.summary: Beijing just asked our government to muzzle its own people, specifically those who show the public what happens in the West Philippine Sea. And now there are voices here saying perhaps we should oblige, perhaps transparency has done its job, perhaps it is time to be quiet for the sake of good relations. Before we go down that road, we should ask a simple question: Why does China want us quiet, and who benefits if we are?
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.summary_zh: 北京刚刚要求我国政府压制自己的民众，尤其是那些向公众展示西菲律宾海发生了什么的人。如今，国内又有人声称，也许我们应当照办，也许透明度已经完成了自己的使命，也许为了保持良好关系，是时候保持沉默。在我们走上这条道路之前，应当提出一个简单的问题：中国为什么希望我们保持沉默？如果我们保持沉默，谁将从中受益？
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.body: That sounds good. Nobody in the Philippine government is against keeping an open line of communication with China. But I read the other side’s version, too, and I suggest every Filipino do the same. In Xinhua’s account, Wang told Lazaro that relations are suffering from malicious interference by a small number of Filipino politicians who keep attacking China and crossing its red lines. He asked Manila to tighten its oversight of the individuals concerned and speak with one rational, unified voice on China. So let us not pretend this was only about lowering the temperature. Beijing just asked our government to muzzle its own people, specifically those who show the public what happens in the West Philippine Sea. And now there are voices here saying perhaps we should oblige, perhaps transparency has done its job, perhaps it is time to be quiet for the sake of good relations. Before we go down that road, we should ask a simple question: Why does China want us quiet, and who benefits if we are? I have been part of this since the beginning, so let me explain what transparency actually did. Before 2023, what happened at sea stayed at sea. The China Coast Guard would block us, ram us and hit us with water cannons, and the public would find out, if at all, through a diplomatic note filed weeks later. Beijing’s denial would come out the same afternoon. We began releasing videos, photographs, the exact time and location of each incident, and the legal basis for Philippine presence and jurisdiction, usually within hours. The water cannon attacks at Bajo de Masinloc. The military-grade laser pointed at our crew. The ramming of resupply boats at Ayungin. The swarming of vessels in our exclusive economic zone. All of it is now on the record, documented not only by Filipinos who were there with us but also by independent foreign journalists who witnessed these incidents firsthand. Yes, we deliberately leveraged one of our most cherished democratic values — freedom of the press — to help us tell the world the truth. China can still deny what happened, but it must now contend with photographic and video evidence. In the past, Beijing could more easily control the narrative, using malign influence operations to shape domestic and international public opinion. Our transparency initiative has fundamentally changed that dynamic, severely constraining China’s ability to manipulate information and distort the facts. Anyone working in defense or foreign policy who fails to understand these dynamics and their implications for long-term Philippine interests is neglecting a fundamental responsibility. Here is the first thing China gains if we go quiet: The world goes quiet with us. When Washington, Tokyo, Canberra, Ottawa, Brussels or the G7 condemn the actions of the China Coast Guard in our waters, they are not reacting to our news conferences. They are reacting to the footage we release. A foreign minister can issue a statement of concern based on compelling video evidence. No government issues such a statement based on rumors, much less on a confidential note verbale or diplomatic démarche delivered weeks after the incident. The same footage helps sustain the security partnerships we have built. Every like-minded government has to explain to its own parliament and people why it signs a maritime cooperation agreement with Manila, why its coast guard sails with ours and why it helps support our modernization. The daily record of Chinese behavior in the West Philippine Sea is their justification. Take it away, and supporting the Philippines becomes an abstraction. Abstractions do not survive a budget hearing. Beijing knows this. I am not sure all of our own officials do. When dealing with an actor that has lied many times and fooled us on numerous occasions, silence does not buy us greater diplomatic space. It simply takes us back to how things were before 2023, when China kept pushing the envelope and we filed diplomatic protests whose full contents nobody ever saw. China has learned from our last two elections that being seen as close to Beijing is now a liability in Philippine politics. Candidates who once proudly boasted of their friendship with China now prefer to change the subject. It is difficult to campaign on the claim that China is our friend when voters can see, on their own phones, Chinese Coast Guard vessels firing water cannons at Philippine Coast Guard ships, threatening Filipino fishermen and depriving them of their livelihoods. Beijing’s answer to that problem is not to change how it behaves at sea. It is to make sure nobody sees it anymore. If transparency ends in 2027, the West Philippine Sea is out of the news by 2028. People forget. The field is then wide open for politicians who owe Beijing, backed by Beijing’s money, to take back Malacañang and put the next president on a leash for six years. It is about who sits in the Palace after 2028 and whether that person answers to the Filipino people or to someone else. One last detail from this week, because it tells you everything about who we are dealing with. Our DFA says Secretary Lazaro received the call from Wang. Xinhua says Wang took the call at Lazaro’s request. China’s malign influence operators got to work and reinforced this messaging to make the Philippines appear desperate. The Chinese term they used, 应约, is the formula Beijing uses when the other side asked for the conversation. In other words, the two governments cannot agree on who picked up the phone first. In December 2023, Beijing said then-Secretary Manalo had requested his call with Wang. Diplomatic sources in Manila insisted it was the Chinese side that called. Twice now, on the most trivial of things in diplomacy, China has told the world a different story from the one it told us. Both times, the story made the Philippines look like the one coming to Beijing, hat in hand, to patch things up. And this latest one came barely two weeks after their ambassador reminded us that China could easily win if it chose to use force. And now Beijing is asking us to trust its good faith and stop documenting what its ships do in our own waters. If China is willing to rewrite the record of a phone call, what would stop it from doing the same with a water cannon attack, a ramming incident or the next confrontation at Bajo de Masinloc or Ayungin? Without footage from our side, Beijing would be free to push its version of events, with little evidence available to challenge it. Diplomacy with China remains necessary, but it must never come at the expense of documenting what happens in our waters. Footage provides evidence that Beijing cannot simply dismiss or explain away. A country that cannot be honest about who dialed cannot be trusted to be honest about anything that matters more. Your subscription could not be saved. Please try again. https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.title_zh: 北京为何希望我们保持沉默
https://www.inquirer.net/494905/why-beij.body_zh: 听起来不错。菲律宾政府中没有人反对同中国保持公开的沟通渠道。但我也读了对方的说法，并建议每一位菲律宾人都这么做。在新华社的报道中，王表示，菲中关系正受到少数菲律宾政治分子的恶意干扰；他们不断攻击中国，并越过中国的红线。他要求马尼拉加强对相关人员的监督，并以理性、统一的立场对华发声。因此，我们不要假装这只是为了降温。北京只是要求我国政府封住本国人的嘴，尤其是那些向公众展示西菲律宾海实际情况的人。现在，这里甚至有人认为，也许我们应当照办，也许透明度已经完成了自己的使命，也许为了良好关系，现在该保持沉默了。在我们走上这条路之前，应该提出一个简单的问题：中国为什么希望我们保持沉默，而我们保持沉默又将使谁受益？我从一开始就参与其中，所以让我解释透明度究竟发挥了什么作用。在2023年以前，海上发生的事只留在海上。中国海警会阻挡我们、冲撞我们并用水炮袭击我们，而公众即使最终得知此事，也只能通过数周后提交的外交照会。新华社的报道版本也是如此。我们开始发布视频、照片、每起事件发生的准确时间和地点，以及菲律宾存在和管辖权的法律依据，通常在数小时内公布。对巴焦德马辛洛克水炮袭击的记录。针对我们船员照射的军用激光。对阿永金岛补给船的冲撞。在我国专属经济区聚集船只。如今，这一切都已记录在案，不仅有与我们同在现场菲律宾人的记录，还有独立外国记者对这些事件的第一手见证。是的，我们有意利用了一项最珍视的民主价值——新闻自由——帮助我们向世界讲述真相。中国仍能否认发生过的事情，但现在它必须面对照片和视频证据。过去，北京更容易控制叙事，利用恶意影响行动塑造国内外公众舆论。我们的透明度倡议从根本上改变了这种态势，严重限制了中國操纵信息和歪曲事实的能力。任何从事国防或外交工作的人，如果不能理解这些态势及其对菲律宾长期利益的影响，就是在逃避一项基本责任。如果我们保持沉默，中国首先得到的好处就是：世界也会随我们一同沉默。当华盛顿、东京、堪培拉、渥太华、布鲁塞尔或七国集团谴责中国海警在我国水域的行动时，他们回应的是我们公布的影像，而不是我们的新闻发布会。外交部长可以依据有力的视频证据发表关切声明。没有哪个政府会依据传闻发表这样的声明，更不会依据事件数周后才提交的秘密照会或外交交涉。同一批影像也有助于维持我们建立的安全伙伴关系。每一个持相同立场的政府，都必须向本国议会和民众解释：为什么与马尼拉签署海上合作协议，为什么其海警与我国海警共同航行，以及为什么支持我国的现代化。中国在西菲律宾海的日常行为记录就是这些解释的依据。一旦拿走这些记录，支持菲律宾就会变成一种抽象概念。抽象概念无法通过预算听证会。北京知道这一点。我不确定我们所有官员都知道。面对一个多次说谎、多次欺骗我们的行为体，沉默不会为我们争取更多外交空间，只会把我们带回2023年以前的状态：那时中国不断试探边界，而我们提交的外交抗议，其完整内容从未有人看到。中国已经从我们最近两次选举中吸取教训：如今，在菲律宾政治中，被视为与北京关系密切已是一项负担。过去曾自豪炫耀与中国友好关系的候选人，如今更愿意转移话题。当选民能在自己的手机上看到中国海警船只向菲律宾海警船只发射水炮、威胁菲律宾渔民并夺走他们的生计时，很难再以“中国是我们的朋友”为竞选主张。北京对这一问题的回答，不是改变其在海上的行为，而是确保再也没有人看到。如果透明度在2027年终结，到2028年，西菲律宾海就会从新闻中消失。人们会忘记。到那时，受北京资助、欠北京人情的政客便可以毫无阻碍地重新夺回马拉卡尼昂宫，并让下一任总统在六年内受其牵制。问题在于2028年后谁将入住总统府，以及那个人效忠于菲律宾人民，还是另一个人。本周还有一个细节，因为它能说明我们面对的是怎样的人。我们的外交部表示，秘书长拉扎罗接听了王的电话。新华社则称，王应拉扎罗的请求接听电话。中国的恶意影响操盘手随即展开工作，强化这一说法，让菲律宾显得迫不及待。他们使用的中文词“应约”，是北京在对方请求会谈时使用的表述。换言之，两国政府甚至无法就谁先拨通电话达成一致。2023年12月，北京称时任部长马纳洛要求与王通话；马尼拉的外交消息人士则坚称，是中方打来的。外交中最琐碎的事情，中国已经两次向世界讲述了与我们所听不同的版本。两次，这种说法都让菲律宾显得像是主动向北京低头，希望修补关系。而最新一次说法出现前不到两周，其大使还提醒我们，如果中国愿意使用武力，就能轻易获胜。如今，北京却要求我们信任它的善意，并停止记录其船只在我国水域的行为。如果中国连谁拨通电话都愿意改写，它还有什么理由不会对水炮袭击、冲撞事件，或巴焦德马辛洛克和阿永金岛的下一轮对抗做同样的事？如果没有我方影像，北京就能自由推送其事件版本，而几乎没有证据可供质疑。与中国开展外交仍然必要，但绝不能以牺牲记录我国水域所发生之事的透明度为代价。影像提供了北京无法轻易否认或搪塞的证据。一个连谁拨通电话都不肯诚实相告的国家，在更重大的事情上也无法被信任为诚实。你的订阅未能保存。请重试。你的订阅已成功。（Jay Tristan Tarriela海军少将、博士，指挥西菲律宾海透明度小组，并担任菲律宾海警在西菲律宾海事务上的发言人。他拥有东京国家政策研究大学院（GRIPS）授予的博士学位，以及由GRIPS和日本海岸警卫队学院联合授予的硕士学位。）如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们的西菲律宾海动态专题页面。通过文章、视频和专家观点持续了解最新情况。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: NEW YORK — AI stocks are bouncing back Friday and recovering some of their sell-off from the last two days. The rest of the U.S. stock market is mixed following a whirlwind few days of Wall Street trying to sort out what this week’s sweeping victories by Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections will mean for the economy. The S&P 500 rose 0.9 percent and trimmed its loss for the week to 2.1 percent. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 3 points, or less than 0.1 percent, as of 11:45 a.m. Eastern time, and the Nasdaq composite was 1.6 percent higher. Even with this week's extreme swings, the S&P 500 remains only 5.1 percent below its all-time high, which was set last month. It and other companies tied to the build-out of AI data centers tumbled this week on worries that Democratic victories in statehouses across the country could mean a slowdown in further construction, particularly in Texas. Voters across political parties say they’re wary about AI and don’t like increases to power bills caused by data centers. That built on top of worries already rattling the industry that further construction of AI data centers may slow because of how expensive it’s become to borrow money. Before that, even, critics were saying AI stock prices had shot too high and were in a bubble. But political power in Washington will still be split between a Democratic Congress and a White House run by the Republican Trump, who retains the power to veto. That could limit federal efforts to rein in the AI industry. In the meantime, companies in the industry still see strong growth. IREN, a company that delivers data centers, compute and software for AI training, reported stronger results for the latest quarter than analysts expected. Its stock jumped 19.5 percent, and it also announced two new contracts signed since the end of the quarter. “We own the land, the power and the data centers under all of it, which gives us more ways to fund growth and lets us set its pace,” co-CEO Daniel Roberts said. Lam Research, a company whose equipment and services help make semiconductors, climbed 9.9 percent after announcing a program to send up to $25 billion to its investors by buying back shares of its own stock. That helped other stocks that have benefited from the build-out of AI data centers recover some of their own sharp losses. CoreWeave, which rents out access to AI chips to customers over the cloud, rose 4.5 percent. Micron Technology, which sells memory for computers, climbed 5.9 percent. Outside of AI, the U.S. stock market was mixed, and slightly more stocks fell within the S&P 500 than rose. Axon Enterprise tumbled 17.6 percent after the seller of Tasers reported weaker results for the latest quarter than analysts expected. It also announced a $1.2 billion investment in Skydio, a drone technology company. Charter Communications sank 5 percent after the internet and video provider reported a loss for the latest quarter, when analysts were expecting a profit. In the bond market, Treasury yields recovered some of their sharp drops from earlier in the week, triggered by tumbling stock prices and hopes that split control of Washington could limit how much more the U.S. government adds to its debt. The yield on the 10-year Treasury edged up to 4.85 percent from 4.84 percent late Thursday. It had topped 5.30 percent last month when worries about inflation, higher interest rates and rising government debt were spiking. Helping to support yields was a report showing U.S. employers hired many more workers last month than economists expected. It’s the latest signal that the U.S. economy continues to chug along despite high inflation. On one hand, the encouraging data could mean the U.S. economy may be able to absorb a slowdown in construction of AI data centers. But at the same time, the strong growth in jobs could push upward on inflation. Following the report, traders saw a greater probability of the Federal Reserve hiking its short-term interest rate at its next meeting in December, according to data from CME Group. Rate hikes by the Fed can rein in inflation, but they do so by making borrowing money more expensive for everyone and slowing the overall economy. A separate report, meanwhile, suggested that sentiment among U.S. consumers unexpectedly improved. The preliminary report from the University of Michigan said sentiment rose for lower- and middle-wealth Americans but fell for those with the largest stock portfolios. Perhaps more importantly for the bond market, the survey also suggested expectations for inflation in the coming year eased for Americans. That could prevent a vicious cycle where expectations for high inflation drive behavior that only worsens inflation

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 纽约消息——人工智能股票周五反弹，收复了过去两天抛售的部分跌幅。在华尔街经历了一连串跌宕起伏、试图判断本周民主党在美国中期选举中取得广泛胜利将如何影响经济之后，美国股市其余板块涨跌互现。标普500指数上涨0.9%，全周跌幅收窄至2.1%。截至东部时间上午11时45分，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌3点，跌幅不足0.1%；纳斯达克综合指数上涨1.6%。尽管本周行情剧烈波动，标普500指数仍仅比上月创下的历史高点低5.1%。该指数成分股及其他与人工智能数据中心建设相关的公司本周重挫，原因包括担心民主党在全国各州议会获胜可能意味着进一步建设放缓，尤其是在得克萨斯州。各政治派别的选民表示，他们对人工智能持谨慎态度，也不喜欢数据中心推高电费。这一因素又叠加了已经令该行业不安的担忧：由于借贷成本大幅上升，人工智能数据中心的进一步建设可能放缓。此前，甚至已有批评者称人工智能股票价格涨得过高，存在泡沫。不过，华盛顿的政治权力仍将由民主党控制的国会和共和党人特朗普掌控的白宫分享，特朗普仍保留否决权。这可能限制联邦政府监管人工智能行业的努力。与此同时，该行业公司仍预计将实现强劲增长。IREN是一家提供人工智能训练所需数据中心、算力和软件的公司，其最新季度业绩好于分析师预期。该公司股价上涨19.5%，并宣布在季度结束后又签署了两份新合同。联席首席执行官丹尼尔·罗伯茨说：“我们拥有土地、电力以及贯穿其中的数据中心，这使我们有更多方式为增长提供资金，也能自行掌控增长速度。”半导体制造设备和服务企业Lam Research宣布一项计划，通过回购自身股票向投资者返还最多250亿美元后，股价上涨9.9%。这也帮助其他受益于人工智能数据中心建设的股票收复了部分大幅跌幅。CoreWeave通过云端向客户提供人工智能芯片使用服务，股价上涨4.5%。销售计算机存储芯片的美光科技上涨5.9%。人工智能板块之外，美国股市涨跌互现，标普500指数成分股中下跌股票略多于上涨股票。Taser制造商Axon Enterprise最新季度业绩不及分析师预期，股价暴跌17.6%。该公司还宣布向无人机技术企业Skydio投资12亿美元。互联网和视频服务提供商Charter Communications最新季度出现亏损，而分析师原本预计其将实现盈利，股价下跌5%。债券市场上，美国国债收益率从本周早些时候的急跌中有所回升；此前股市暴跌，加之市场希望华盛顿的分裂格局能够限制美国政府进一步增加债务，均对收益率走势产生影响。10年期美国国债收益率从周四晚间的4.84%小幅升至4.85%。上月，在通胀、利率上升和政府债务攀升的担忧推动下，该收益率一度突破5.30%。一份报告显示，美国雇主上月招聘的 workers数量远多于经济学家预期，为收益率提供支撑。这是尽管通胀高企，美国经济仍在缓慢运行的最新迹象。一方面，这一令人鼓舞的数据可能意味着美国经济能够承受人工智能数据中心建设放缓；但另一方面，就业的强劲增长可能推高通胀。报告发布后，根据CME Group的数据，交易员认为美联储在12月下一次会议上上调短期利率的可能性更大。美联储加息能够抑制通胀，但方式是提高所有人的借贷成本，并拖累整体经济。与此同时，另一份报告显示，美国消费者信心意外改善。密歇根大学的初步报告称，中低收入和中等财富美国人的信心上升，但股票投资组合规模最大的群体信心下降Perhaps对债券市场而言更重要的是，调查还显示，美国人对未来一年通胀的预期有所缓和。这可能避免形成恶性循环：高通胀预期驱动相关行为，而这些行为只会进一步加剧通胀

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: JoongAng Ilbo buyers have financial room to fund acquisition: KIS report
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: In an unconventional lifeline for Korea's traditional press, a diverse corporate coalition spanning tech, retail and entertainment has agreed to rescue JoongAng Ilbo, one of the nation’s most influential conservative daily newspapers. According to an assessment by Korea Investors Service (KIS), a Moody’s affiliate, the acquiring companies possess the financial capacity to comfortably fund the transaction.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 作为韩国传统媒体的一项非同寻常的纾困措施，一个横跨科技、零售和娱乐行业的多元企业联盟同意救助《中日报》，这是韩国最具影响力的保守派日报之一。据穆迪关联机构韩国投资者服务（KIS）评估，收购这些企业拥有充足财力，可以轻松为交易提供资金。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: This article is part of a series utilizing data and reports provided by Korea Investors Service (KIS) to offer our readers in-depth insights on industry trends, corporate fiscal health and M&A deals. In an unconventional lifeline for Korea's traditional press, a diverse corporate coalition spanning tech, retail and entertainment has agreed to rescue JoongAng Ilbo, one of the nation’s most influential conservative daily newspapers. Under a 520 billion won ($388 million) conditional agreement approved Wednesday by the boards of Daou Technology, Saramin, CJ Corp. and Shinsegae, the newly injected capital will flow directly into the newspaper to clear its debts and pull the media outlet out of a creditor-led workout program it entered this summer. According to an assessment by Korea Investors Service (KIS), a Moody’s affiliate, the acquiring companies possess the financial capacity to comfortably fund the transaction. Under the agreed funding structure, Daou Technology will cover 36.5 percent of the total, or about 189.8 billion won, while CJ Corp. will contribute 35.7 percent, or 185.6 billion won. Shinsegae is participating alongside CJ as a financial investor with a 14.1 percent stake (73.3 billion won), and online job portal Saramin will provide 13.7 percent (71.2 billion won). Daou Technology and Saramin both operate under the Daou Kiwoom Group. Industry risk: Limited — KIS sees limited credit risk for CJ (AA-) and Shinsegae (AA). It sees a manageable, though rising, debt burden for Daou Technology (A). Key credit drivers: The deal still needs a creditors’ meeting on Nov. 6 and a bondholders’ meeting on Nov. 17, and final funding plans are pending. Also, Korean law caps any large business group at 50 percent of a daily newspaper, so the two camps will hold about 47 percent each. Key player profiles: Daou Technology: An IT services company at the center of Daou Kiwoom Group. It owns 42.45 percent of Kiwoom Securities. Its share of the deal is 36.5 percent, the largest of any investor. Saramin: An online job portal and Daou Kiwoom Group affiliate. It provides 13.7 percent of the investment. CJ Corp.: The holding company of CJ Group, whose businesses span food and entertainment. It is rated AA- by KIS and provides 35.7 percent of the deal. CJ already owned a 9.24 percent stake in JoongAng Ilbo through CJ OliveNetworks. Shinsegae: A department store operator rated AA by KIS. It joins the CJ side as a financial investor with 14.1 percent of the deal. JoongAng Ilbo: A Korean daily newspaper that entered a creditor-led workout this summer after liquidity problems at its parent group. It defaulted on a 137 billion won bond issue in June. According to an evaluation by KIS — authored by researchers Lee Ju-ho, Kim Young-hun and Sung Ho-jae — the financial impact of the transaction will vary based on each participant's individual capacity and contribution size, though none of the rated participants face an immediate threat to their credit standing. Daou Technology, stepping in as the largest single investor, carries the heaviest exposure. KIS noted that increased borrowing is "unavoidable" in the short term, as the IT services firm is already heavily invested in building a cloud data center in Jukjeon, Yongin, Gyeonggi Province. Even so, the agency deemed the burden "bearable," given the company’s underlying cash generation and financial flexibility. Daou Technology currently carries an A rating with a stable outlook on Korea’s domestic scale. The company’s standalone finances remained solid heading into the transaction. During the first half of the year, it posted 209.7 billion won in revenue and 36 billion won in operating profit, yielding a 17.2 percent operating margin. As of late June, its debt-to-equity ratio stood at 61.8 percent, backed by 284.9 billion won in cash and financial instruments against total borrowings of 385.5 billion won, while its EBITDA covered interest costs by 8.3 times. In a stress-tested scenario modeled by KIS — assuming Daou Technology independently finances half of a 500 billion won deal entirely through new debt — net debt would climb from 100.7 billion won to 350.7 billion won, pushing the debt-to-equity ratio to 90.5 percent and the net debt-to-EBITDA ratio from 1.1x to 3.9x. Because KIS views a 5.0x net debt-to-EBITDA ratio — combined with margin compression and delayed business execution — as a downgrade trigger, the projected 3.9x ratio remains safely below that threshold. Workout — A restructuring program led by creditors. It gives a struggling company time to repay its debts without going into court receivership. Preferred bidder — The bidder chosen to hold exclusive talks with the seller before a final deal is signed. Subscribing to new shares — Buying newly issued shares. The money goes to the company itself, not to its existing shareholders. Debt-to-equity ratio — A company’s total liabilities divided by its shareholders’ equity. A higher figure means the company relies more on borrowed money. EBITDA — Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization. It is a rough measure of the cash a business generates from its operations. Net debt to EBITDA — The number of years it would take a company to pay off its net debt from its cash earnings. A lower number is safer. KIS noted that Daou Technology can also rely on steady earnings from its core IT service operations, which hold leading market positions in their sectors and draw consistent demand from group affiliates. Supplemental cash inflows from subsidiary dividends — most notably from Kiwoom Securities, which has been expanding its dividend payouts — further reinforce the company's cash flow profile. The agency added that Daou Tech’s 42.45 percent stake in the online brokerage, alongside its other asset holdings, provides substantial financial flexibility to absorb the deal. For CJ and Shinsegae, KIS noted that the effect on their credit ratings would be limited, given their strong earning power and financial capacity relative to the expected size of their investments. CJ serves as the holding company for a major conglomerate spanning food, logistics and entertainment, and it carries an AA- rating with a stable outlook on Korea’s domestic scale. On a standalone basis as of the end of June, the company maintained a conservative balance sheet with total borrowings of 299.5 billion won and a debt-to-equity ratio of just 12 percent. Demonstrating steady cash-generating capability, it posted a standalone operating profit of 106.6 billion won in the first half of the year. Department store operator Shinsegae, rated AA with a stable outlook, has improved its debt profile over the course of the year. On a consolidated basis, its borrowings decreased to 4.96 trillion won at the end of June from 5.33 trillion won at the close of last year, helping drive its debt-to-equity ratio down from 140.9 percent to 121.2 percent. Bolstering this financial standing, the retailer's first-half operating profit climbed to 365 billion won, up from 207.7 billion won during the same period a year earlier. The formation of the consortium is driven in large part by regulatory constraints. Korea’s newspaper law prohibits companies belonging to large business groups subject to cross-shareholding restrictions from owning more than a 50 percent stake in a general daily newspaper. Because Daou Kiwoom, CJ and Shinsegae all fall under this restricted category, forming the multi-party consortium serves as a legal workaround. Following the transaction, each of the two primary investor camps is expected to hold approximately 47 percent of the publication. Korea Investors Service (KIS) says the companies buying a controlling stake in JoongAng Ilbo have the financial capacity to fund the 520 billion won deal. It sees limited credit risk for CJ and Shinsegae and a manageable, though rising, debt burden for Daou Technology, the largest investor. Daou Technology’s actual contribution of about 189.8 billion won is smaller than the 250 billion won the agency used in its scenario, which keeps its key debt ratios below downgrade thresholds. The money will go to JoongAng Ilbo to repay debt and help it exit a creditor-led workout. This article was based on a Korea Investors Service (KIS) report and translated and edited by The Korea Times using generative AI
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: KIS报告：中日报买方有能力为收购提供资金
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh:
本文是系列报道之一，利用Korea Investors Service（KIS）提供的数据和报告，为读者深入解读行业趋势、企业财务状况和并购交易。在为韩国传统媒体提供非传统救命援助的行动中，一个横跨科技、零售和娱乐行业的企业联盟同意救助《中央日报》，这是韩国最具影响力的保守派日报之一。根据Daou Technology、Saramin、CJ Corp.和Shinsegae董事会周三批准的一项总额5200亿韩元（3.88亿美元）的有条件协议，新注入的资金将直接进入该报，用于清偿债务，使其退出今年夏季进入的债权人主导的重组计划。Korea Investors Service（KIS）是一家Moody’s关联机构；该机构评估认为，参与收购的企业拥有轻松为这笔交易提供资金的财务能力。按照商定的资金结构，Daou Technology将承担总额的36.5%，约1898亿韩元；CJ Corp.将出资35.7%，即1856亿韩元。Shinsegae将与CJ一同作为财务投资者参与，出资比例14.1%，金额为733亿韩元；在线招聘网站Saramin将出资13.7%，即712亿韩元。Daou Technology和Saramin均隶属于Daou Kiwoom Group。

行业风险：有限。KIS认为，CJ（AA-）和Shinsegae（AA）的信用风险有限；对Daou Technology（A）而言，债务负担可控，但正在上升。

主要信用驱动因素：交易仍需在11月6日召开债权人会议，并在11月17日召开债券持有人会议，最终出资方案尚待确定。此外，韩国法律将任何大型企业集团持有一家日报50%的股份上限，因此两个投资阵营将各持有约47%的股份。

主要参与者概况：

Daou Technology：一家位于Daou Kiwoom Group核心地位的IT服务公司，持有Kiwoom Securities 42.45%的股份。其出资占交易的36.5%，是所有投资者中占比最大的一家。

Saramin：一家在线招聘网站，也是Daou Kiwoom Group的关联企业，为交易提供13.7%的资金。

CJ Corp.：CJ Group的控股公司，业务涵盖食品和娱乐。KIS给予其AA-评级，该公司在交易中出资35.7%。CJ此前已通过CJ OliveNetworks持有《中央日报》9.24%的股份。

Shinsegae：一家百货商店运营商，KIS给予其AA评级。它作为财务投资者加入CJ一方，出资占交易的14.1%。

《中央日报》：一家韩国日报，因其母集团出现流动性问题，于今年夏季进入债权人主导的重组计划。该报曾于6月违约一笔1370亿韩元的债券。KIS由Lee Ju-ho、Kim Young-hun和Sung Ho-jae研究人员撰写的评估显示，该交易对各参与方财务状况的影响将因各方自身资金实力和出资规模而异，但获得评级的参与方均未面临信用评级立即受威胁的情况。作为最大单一投资者介入的Daou Technology承担的风险敞口最重。KIS指出，这家IT服务公司已经投入大量资金在京畿道龙仁竹田建设云数据中心，短期内增加借款“不可避免”。尽管如此，考虑到该公司稳健的现金创造能力和财务灵活性，该机构认为这一负担“可以承受”。Daou Technology目前按韩国国内评级体系获评A，评级展望稳定。交易临近之际，该公司的独立财务状况保持稳健。今年上半年，公司实现营收2097亿韩元、营业利润360亿韩元，营业利润率为17.2%。截至6月下旬，其债务权益比率为61.8%，持有现金和金融工具2849亿韩元，而借款总额为3855亿韩元；其EBITDA对利息成本的覆盖倍数为8.3倍。

KIS进行的压力测试情景假设Daou Technology独立通过新增债务为一笔5000亿韩元交易的一半提供全部资金。在这一情景下，其净债务将从1007亿韩元升至3507亿韩元，债务权益比率将升至90.5%，净债务与EBITDA之比则将从1.1倍升至3.9倍。由于KIS将5.0倍净债务与EBITDA之比，连同利润率收缩和业务执行延迟，视为触发评级下调的因素，预计的3.9倍仍远低于该门槛。

Workout——由债权人主导的重组计划，为陷入困境的公司争取偿还债务的时间，避免进入法院接管程序。

Preferred bidder——在最终交易签署前获选与卖方进行独家谈判的竞买方。

Subscribing to new shares——认购新发行的股份。资金进入公司本身，而非其现有股东手中。

Debt-to-equity ratio——公司的总负债除以股东权益。数值越高，意味着公司对借入资金的依赖程度越高。

EBITDA——息税折旧摊销前利润，是衡量企业经营活动产生现金能力的粗略指标。

Net debt to EBITDA——公司以现金收益偿清净债务所需的年数。数值越低越安全。

KIS指出，Daou Technology还可依靠核心IT服务业务的稳定收益。这些业务在各自领域占据领先市场地位，并持续获得集团关联企业的需求。子公司股息带来的额外现金流入进一步增强了公司的现金流状况，其中尤以Kiwoom Securities最为显著，该公司的股息派发一直在增加。该机构补充称，Daou Tech持有这家在线券商42.45%的股份，加上其他资产，使公司拥有充足的财务灵活性来消化这笔交易。

对于CJ和Shinsegae，KIS指出，鉴于两家公司雄厚的盈利能力和相对于预期投资规模的财务实力，交易对其信用评级的影响有限。CJ是一家横跨食品、物流和娱乐行业的大型企业集团的控股公司，按韩国国内评级体系获评AA-，评级展望稳定。截至6月末，公司独立财务状况保持保守，借款总额为2995亿韩元，债务权益比率仅为12%。公司展现出稳定的现金创造能力，今年上半年实现独立营业利润1066亿韩元。百货商店运营商Shinsegae获评AA，评级展望稳定，其债务状况在年内有所改善。按合并口径计算，其借款额从去年年底的5.33万亿韩元降至6月底的4.96万亿韩元，推动债务权益比率从140.9%降至121.2%。这家零售商今年上半年营业利润增至3650亿韩元，高于上年同期的2077亿韩元，进一步夯实了其财务状况。

该联盟的成立在很大程度上受到监管限制的推动。韩国《报纸法》禁止受交叉持股限制的大型企业集团所属公司持有一家综合日报50%以上的股份。由于Daou Kiwoom、CJ和Shinsegae均属于这一受限类别，多方联盟便成为一项合法的变通安排。交易完成后，预计两大主要投资者阵营将各持有该报约47%的股份。

Korea Investors Service（KIS）表示，收购《中央日报》控股权的公司拥有为这笔5200亿韩元交易提供资金的财务能力。该机构认为，CJ和Shinsegae的信用风险有限，而作为最大投资者的Daou Technology面临的债务负担虽在上升，但仍然可控。Daou Technology实际出资约1898亿韩元，低于该机构情景分析中采用的2500亿韩元，因此其主要债务比率仍低于评级下调门槛。这笔资金将用于帮助《中央日报》偿还债务并退出债权人主导的重组计划。

本文依据Korea Investors Service（KIS）的报告撰写，由《韩国时报》使用生成式人工智能翻译并编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: 17 party leadership election that the anti-President Lee Jae Myung faction within the party and Shincheonji had formed a secret alliance. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 党内反李在明派与新天地教会曾结成秘密联盟的党内领导人选举第17届。由于对郑氏提出严重指控并委托调查，金某如今面临压力，必须解释其主张的依据，以及为何调查结果不向公众公布。他补充称，尽管目前仍保留党内领导人职务，但其实际权威已经大幅削弱。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: On Friday, Kim apologized again during the party’s Supreme Council meeting. It was his third apology over the controversy, following remarks at Tuesday’s closed-door meeting of party lawmakers and on the party’s YouTube channel on Thursday. “I once again offer my apologies to everyone who was hurt as I raised serious concerns and warned about religious interference in politics during the party’s leadership election,” Kim said. He was referring to his allegation in the run-up to the Aug. 17 party leadership election that the anti-President Lee Jae Myung faction within the party and Shincheonji had formed a secret alliance. The claim targeted the camp of his leadership rival, former Chairman Rep. Jung Chung-rae. After raising the allegation and winning the leadership race, Kim commissioned an investigation into the claims. Although it was found that there are a considerable number of people suspected of being Shincheonji followers, that finding alone did not show their membership was linked to the faction backing Jung. Kim’s latest apology did little to satisfy Jung’s allies, who demanded a direct apology to those targeted and concrete steps toward accountability. The reversal leaves Kim facing a problem larger than an insufficient apology. Having raised a serious accusation against Jung, a leading figure in a major party faction, and commissioned the investigation, Kim now faces pressure to explain the basis for his claims — and why the findings are not being released publicly. Kim’s pledge to restore party unity may prove difficult to fulfill if his explanation raises more questions than it answers. Rather than settling the controversy, the handling of the findings could further deepen the factional divide. The party began allowing sitting lawmakers and constituency committee heads to inspect the investigation report individually at the secretary-general’s office on Friday, with access available through Nov. 13. The materials will not be distributed separately. That limited disclosure could become another flashpoint. If Jung’s allies conclude after reviewing the available findings that there is no evidence of the alleged alliance, they could intensify demands for Kim to take responsibility. “This is clearly, to put it simply, a ticking time bomb," Kim Sung-soo, a professor of political science at Hanyang University, told The Korea Times. "So his leadership has clearly suffered a devastating blow. And that, in my view, is probably why President Lee Jae Myung started a YouTube channel. Lee may have felt a sense of crisis — a concern that Kim’s leadership was no longer secure.” The professor said restricting access to the findings would not prevent some lawmakers from leaking them, leaving the chairman vulnerable to further disclosures. Although he has retained his position as party leader for now, his actual authority had already been substantially weakened, he added. The controversy could also extend beyond political accountability to a criminal investigation. Supreme Council member Lee Sung-yoon has called for an examination of whether Kim’s statements violated Article 52 of the Political Parties Act, which penalizes the publication of false statements in party leadership elections. Under the provision covering false statements intended to prevent a candidate’s election, a conviction can carry up to five years in prison or a fine of 10 million won ($7,400). The party chairman’s apologies and follow-up measures have not ended the backlash from Jung’s allies. Posts demanding Kim's resignation have continued to appear in online communities frequented by Jung’s supporters. Jung has also demanded that Kim publicly explain how he intends to take responsibility. “Humiliating and confusing party members and exposing the party to grave risks constitutes an act against the party,” Jung wrote on social media. “He should also publicly state what responsibility he intends to take for that.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 封面报道：新天地教会反制引发反弹，执政党领袖的信誉受到考验
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 周五，金在党的最高委员会会议上再次道歉。这已是他围绕这场争议作出的第三次道歉，此前他分别在周二党内议员闭门会议后，以及周四通过该党的YouTube频道发表言论时致歉。金说：“我再次向所有因我在党内领导层选举期间提出严重关切，并警告宗教干预政治而受到伤害的人道歉。”他指的是，在8月17日党内领导层选举前夕提出的指控，即党内反总统李在明派与新天地结成了秘密联盟。该说法针对的是其领导权竞争对手、党前主席郑清莱阵营。提出这一指控并赢得领导层竞选后，金委托对此说法展开调查。调查发现，有相当数量的人被怀疑是新天地信徒，但这一发现本身并不能证明他们的成员身份与支持郑清莱的派系有关。金最新的一次道歉并未平息郑清莱盟友的不满，他们要求金直接向被指控者道歉，并采取具体措施追究责任。这一逆转令金面临的问题并不只是道歉不够充分。在对郑清莱——一个主要党内派系的重要人物——提出严重指控并委托调查后，金如今面临压力，必须解释其说法的依据，以及为何调查结果不向公众公布。如果金的解释引出的疑问多于其回答的问题，那么他恢复党内团结的承诺可能难以兑现。处理调查结果的方式非但没有平息争议，反而可能进一步加深派系分裂。党方于周五开始允许现任议员和选区委员会负责人到秘书长办公室单独查阅调查报告，查阅期限截至11月13日。相关材料不会单独发放。这种有限度的披露可能成为新的冲突焦点。如果郑清莱的盟友在审阅现有调查结果后认定没有证据证明所称的联盟，他们可能会加强要求金承担责任。汉阳大学政治学教授金成镐对《韩国时报》表示：“说白了，这显然是一颗定时炸弹。因此，他的领导地位显然遭受了毁灭性打击。在我看来，这也可能是总统李在明开设YouTube频道的原因。李可能感到了一种危机感——担心金的领导地位已不再稳固。”这位教授说，限制查阅调查结果并不能阻止部分议员泄露内容，这会使主席进一步暴露于信息披露之中。他补充道，金目前虽然保住了党魁职位，但其实际权威已经大幅削弱。这场争议还可能从政治问责延伸至刑事调查。最高委员会委员李成允呼吁调查金的言论是否违反《政党法》第52条，该条对在党内领导层选举中散布虚假言论的行为予以处罚。根据针对旨在阻止某候选人当选的虚假言论的规定，定罪后最高可判处5年监禁或1,000万韩元（7,400美元）罚款。党主席的道歉及后续措施并未平息郑清莱盟友的反弹。在郑清莱支持者经常光顾的网络社区中，要求金辞职的帖子持续出现。郑清莱还要求金公开说明打算如何承担责任。郑清莱在社交媒体上写道：“羞辱并迷惑党员，使党面临严重风险，构成对党的冒犯行为。他还应当公开说明自己打算为此承担什么责任。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩国卖家正在全球收藏品市场发现新机遇，海外买家愿意为稀有且难以寻得的物品支付溢价。今年第三季度，韩国卖家在 eBay 出售交易卡片的销售额同比增至三倍以上。eBay 周五表示，今年7月至9月，在该全球电子商务平台上，韩国卖家在“收藏类卡牌游戏”类别中的销售额增幅居所有韩国卖家之首。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korean sellers are finding new opportunities in the global collectibles market, as overseas buyers are willing to pay a premium for rare, hard-to-find items, with trading card sales by Korean sellers on eBay more than tripling year-on-year in the third quarter. EBay said Friday that Korean sellers in the Collectible Card Games Category saw the highest sales growth among all Korean sellers on the global e-commerce platform from July to September this year. Trading cards featuring characters, artists or celebrity athletes fueled platform users’ attraction toward the Korean resellers. The most popular trading cards featured characters from the globally popular animated franchise Pokemon and iconic League of Legends esports team T1. The top-selling item in the category was the 2026 KOREA MEGA FESTA Magikarp card, which also ranked ninth in overall sales among Korean sellers on eBay. The Riftbound X 2025 World Champion T1 Signature Edition Card fetched a premium even during prelaunch sales, demonstrating a global fandom around the product itself and the team represented by professional gamer Lee Sang-hyeok, who is known more widely as Faker. Four of the card’s related products clinched spots in the Top 10 in the category during the third quarter. LEGO was another hot item sold by Korean sellers on eBay. Thanks to the brand, which commonly releases editions featuring popular franchises such as Star Wars and Marvel, the Building Toys Category posted the second-highest sales growth among Korean sellers in the three-month period. Those that were no longer produced or were manufactured in a limited volume were in high demand among Korean sellers. The LEGO 10190 Market Street set, for example, was ultimately purchased for $4,271 — 57 times its original retail price. K-pop merchandise also attracted demand from global fans. BIGBANG, which is preparing for a world tour to celebrate its 20th debut anniversary, drew interest from collectors. Merchandise from BTS member J-Hope's collaboration with Japanese fashion brand Human Made and Stray Kids' Run It Seoul concert also attracted international buyers. BTS ranked second only to Michael Jackson in the music category of eBay's quarterly Hot Keywords Report, reflecting continued global interest in the group's merchandise. Tools and workshop equipment also emerged as a growing category for Korean sellers on eBay during the quarter, recording the third-highest sales growth. Popular items included sanders, magnetic drills and vacuum pumps. Korean sellers are finding new opportunities in the global collectibles market, as international buyers increasingly seek out rare and exclusive items. In the trading card category, Korean-language cards account for a much smaller share of available products than their English and Japanese counterparts, but limited Korean editions and exclusive promotional cards are attracting collectors overseas because of their rarity. “Various products presented by Korean sellers, including trading cards, LEGO and K-pop merchandise, are achieving strong results by capturing the attention of global fandoms,” said eBay Japan's Yoo Chang-mo, who is also head of cross-border trade at eBay Korea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 从宝可梦到T1，全球粉丝群体为韩国转售商开辟新市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国卖家正在全球收藏品市场发现新机遇，随着海外买家愿意为稀有且难以寻得的物品支付溢价，韩国卖家第三季度在eBay上的交易卡销售额同比增至三倍以上。eBay周五表示，今年7月至9月，韩国卖家在收藏卡游戏类别的销售额增幅居所有韩国卖家之首。印有角色、艺术家或名人运动员的交易卡，吸引平台用户关注韩国经销商。最受欢迎的交易卡包括全球热门动画系列《宝可梦》中的角色，以及标志性《英雄联盟》电竞战队T1。该类别最畅销的商品是2026 KOREA MEGA FESTA 魔术 Karp卡，这张卡在eBay韩国卖家总销售额中也排名第九。Riftbound X 2025 World Champion T1 Signature Edition Card甚至在预售阶段就获得了溢价，显示出围绕该产品本身以及职业选手李相赫所代表战队的全球粉丝群体。李相赫更为人熟知的名字是Faker。该卡的相关商品中有4款在第三季度跻身该类别销售额前十。LEGO是韩国卖家在eBay上销售的另一件热门商品。凭借这一经常推出《星球大战》和漫威等热门系列版本的品牌，拼装玩具类别在三个月期间的销售额增幅居韩国卖家第二。停产商品或限量制造的商品在韩国卖家中需求旺盛。例如，LEGO 10190 Market Street套装最终以$4,271成交，是其原始零售价的57倍。K-pop周边商品也受到全球粉丝追捧。BIGBANG正在筹备世界巡演，以庆祝出道20周年，吸引了许多收藏家。BTS成员J-Hope与日本时尚品牌Human Made合作推出的周边，以及Stray Kids的Run It Seoul演唱会周边，也吸引了国际买家。在eBay季度热门关键词报告的音乐类别中，BTS仅次于Michael Jackson排名第二，反映出全球市场对该组合周边商品的持续兴趣。工具和工作坊设备在本季度也成为eBay韩国卖家不断增长的商品类别，销售额增幅排名第三。热门商品包括砂磨机、磁力钻和真空泵。随着国际买家越来越 seeks out 稀有和独家商品，韩国卖家正在全球收藏品市场发现新机遇。在交易卡类别中，韩语卡在所有可售商品中的占比远低于英语和日语卡，但限量韩语版和独家促销卡因其稀缺性而吸引海外收藏家。eBay日本公司兼eBay韩国跨境贸易负责人Yoo Chang-mo表示：“韩国卖家推出的各种商品，包括交易卡、LEGO和K-pop周边商品，通过吸引全球粉丝群体，取得了优异的成绩。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/a.summary_zh: 大法官乌瓦尼·穆萨·阿巴·阿吉昨日披露，美国对最高法院一个七人评审小组实施的旅行禁令，源于对该小组成员所作判决的误解。阿巴·阿吉大法官是在阿布贾最高法院举行的、专门向她致敬的告别庭审会议上公布这一消息的。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/a.body: Justice Uwani Musa Abba Aji, yesterday, disclosed that the travel ban imposed on a seven-member panel of the Supreme Court by the United States of America (USA) was occasioned by a misinterpretation of a judgement delivered by members of the panel. Justice Abba Aji, made the disclosure at a special valedictory court session held in her honour at the Supreme Court in Abuja. Abba Aji who was the first female judge from Yobe State and second female Justice from the North-east geopolitical zone, bows out from the judiciary on today (November 7), upon attaining the mandatory 70 years retirement age. The newly retired justice who stated that the ban is still on till date lamented that the ban was part of inconveniences and a small price to pay by judicial officers to preserve the chastity of justice. Recalling her experience while on the bench, she said, “My time on the Supreme Court bench was filled with challenges, some of which have served as additional opportunities to stand firm on the side of justice, regardless of the consequences. She also recalled the year 2016 while on a programme at Washington DC in the USA, she received a call that her attention was needed by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) over a petition against her in Lagos. She explained that the petition made her a regular visitor at the EFCC office answering questions on allegations of corruption she knew nothing about adding that, at the end of the investigations, she was exonerated from all the allegations. Despite the exoneration, she said that the situation was chaotic and made a very difficult time for her as slanders had filled the air, adding that to worsen the situation, she could not speak in her own defense in public because of the conservative nature of the judiciary. The retiring apex court justice, charged the younger generation of judges to hold fast to integrity and let justice be their compass. Specifically, she counselled serving judges to serve with humility and courage and to always remember that the law is not merely a profession but a trust. Earlier, the Chief Justice of Nigeria (CJN), Justice Kudirat Kekere-Ekun, who presided over the special court session congratulated Justice Abba Aji for diligent service to the country’s judiciary and for leaving the Supreme Court bench with an unblemished record of service. The CJN said that the career of Justice Abba Aji in the judiciary and the legal profession was so important to the nation and women who have followed her example on the Bench. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/a.body_zh: 司法大法官乌瓦尼·穆萨·阿巴·阿吉昨天透露，美国对最高法院一个由7名成员组成的小组实施的旅行禁令，是因为误解了该小组成员作出的判决。阿巴·阿吉大法官是在阿布贾最高法院举行的、专门为她举行的荣休庭审会上披露这一消息的。阿巴·阿吉是来自约贝州的首位女性法官，也是尼日利亚东北地缘政治区域的第二名女性大法官。她在达到强制规定的70岁退休年龄后，于今天（11月7日）正式结束司法生涯。这名刚刚退休的大法官表示，该禁令至今仍然有效；她感叹说，这项禁令是司法人员为维护司法纯洁性而承受的诸多不便之一，也是必须付出的微小代价。回顾自己担任法官期间的经历，她说：“我在最高法院法官席上的日子充满挑战，其中一些挑战反而给了我更多机会，让我不计后果地坚持站在正义一边。”她还回忆说，2016年她在美国的华盛顿特区参加一个项目期间，接到经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）的电话，要求她前往拉各斯回应针对她的申诉。她解释说，这项申诉使她经常到经济和金融犯罪委员会办公室回答有关腐败指控的问题，而她对这些指控一无所知；她补充说，调查结束后，所有针对她的指控均被排除。尽管获得了平反，她仍表示当时的局面十分混乱，给她带来了非常艰难的处境，因为诽谤之声四处传播；更糟的是，由于司法系统较为保守，她无法在公开场合为自己辩护。这名即将退休的最高法院大法官告诫年轻一代法官，要坚守诚信，让正义成为自己的指路明灯。具体而言，她劝勉在职法官要以谦逊和勇气履职，并始终牢记，法律不仅是一项职业，更是一种责任。此前，主持特别庭审的尼日利亚首席大法官（CJN）库迪拉特·凯克雷-埃库恩大法官，祝贺阿巴·阿吉大法官为尼日利亚司法系统作出的辛勤贡献，并肯定她以毫无污点的履职记录离开最高法院法官席。首席大法官表示，阿巴·阿吉大法官在司法系统和法律界的职业生涯，对国家和那些以她为榜样走上法官席的女性而言都具有重要意义。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办事处。该报是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过所有平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层报道，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供汇聚新思想、文化与技术的交汇平台。该报是一项公共信托，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育、社区，以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/a.summary_zh: 人民民主党（PDP）阿比奥州分部正式宣布支持博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统在2027年总统选举中再次参选，称这一决定以公平、公正和政治互惠合作为基础。该声明于周四在乌穆阿希亚公布，由该州党主席兼副州长候选人长老阿马·亚伯拉罕在阿比奥州总统竞选委员会（PCC）为总统竞选连任举行就职仪式期间作出。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/a.body: The Abia State chapter of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) has formally declared its support for the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu in the 2027 presidential election, saying the decision is anchored on equity, fairness and mutual political cooperation. The declaration was made on Thursday in Umuahia by the State Chairman of the party and Deputy Governorship Candidate, Elder Amah Abraham, during the inauguration of the Abia State Presidential Campaign Committee (PCC) for the President’s re-election. Speaking on behalf of the PDP Governorship Candidate, Dr. Kelechi Anosike, and the leadership and membership of the party in the state, Amah affirmed the chapter’s commitment to Tinubu’s second-term ambition under the National Rainbow Coalition initiative championed by the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Chief Nyesom Wike. He said the decision was informed by the party’s commitment to political cooperation and its belief that the broader interests of Abia State should take precedence over partisan differences. He declared that the party remains open to genuine collaboration, strategic alliances and coalition arrangements capable of strengthening its position ahead of the 2027 governorship election. Amah noted that the PDP’s willingness to cooperate with the APC at the presidential level should not be misconstrued as an abandonment of its governorship ambition or a surrender of its political identity in Abia State. He expressed confidence in the National Rainbow Coalition initiative being championed by Wike, whom he acknowledged as a national leader of the PDP, describing it as an opportunity for stakeholders across party lines to build bridges, promote understanding and establish alliances that accommodate their respective interests. Amah reaffirmed that the Abia PDP remains committed to constructive engagement with all stakeholders who share its vision of building a stronger, more competitive and more accountable political leadership in the state. The inauguration was attended by party leaders, stakeholders and supporters from across the 17 local government areas of the state. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/a.title_zh: 阿比亚州人民民主党支持蒂努布连任，并要求州长竞选实行对等原则
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/07/a.body_zh: 阿比亚州人民民主党（PDP）分部已正式宣布支持博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统在2027年总统选举中寻求连任，并表示这一决定以公平、公正和相互政治合作为基础。该声明于周四在乌穆阿希亚宣布。人民民主党州主席兼州长候选人长老阿马·亚伯拉罕在阿比亚州总统竞选委员会（PCC）就总统竞选连任举行启动仪式时宣读了声明。阿马代表人民民主党州长候选人凯莱西·阿诺西克博士，以及该党在阿比亚州的领导层和全体党员发言，重申阿比亚州分部支持蒂努布连任第二任期的目标，并支持由联邦首都地区（FCT）部长奈索姆·威克牵头的“全国彩虹联盟”倡议。他说，这一决定体现了该党对政治合作的承诺，也基于这样的信念：阿比亚州的整体利益应优先于党派分歧。他宣布，在2027年州长选举前，该党仍愿与真正有合作意向的各方开展合作，结成战略联盟并达成有助于加强自身地位的联合安排。阿马指出，人民民主党愿意在总统层面与全进步大会党（APC）合作，不应被误解为该党放弃争取州长职位，或在阿比亚州放弃自身政治身份。他对威克牵头的“全国彩虹联盟”倡议充满信心，并认可威克作为人民民主党全国领导人的地位，称这一倡议为跨党派利益相关方搭建沟通桥梁、促进相互理解、建立兼顾各自利益的联盟提供了机会。阿马再次强调，阿比亚州人民民主党仍致力于与所有认同其愿景的利益相关方开展建设性互动，共同建设更强大、更具竞争力、更负责任的州政治领导机构。启动仪式吸引了该党领导层、利益相关方以及来自全州17个地方行政区的支持者出席。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都地区及世界各地设有办公室。该报是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，覆盖各类平台，为政治、商业、专业和外交精英及更广泛的中产阶层服务，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供连接新思想、文化与技术的交汇平台。该报秉持公共信托精神致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，直面人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110702.title: 트럼프와 밀착했다 후폭풍 맞은 빅테크…공화당도 "거리두자"
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110702.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 신재우 기자 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 밀착했다가 중간선거에서 거센 역풍을 맞은 실리콘밸리의 빅테크 기업들이 정치 전략 재정비에 나섰다. 민주당이 의회를 장악하며 인공지능(AI) 규제 강화를 예고한 데다 공화당 내부에서도 기술 업계와 거리를 둬야 한다는 목소리가 커지면서 정치권 양쪽에서 압박받는 처지가 된 것이다. 6일(현지시간) 영국 일간 파이낸셜타임스(FT)에 따르면 AI 기업들은 민주당과 가까운 인사들을 영입하고 규제 수용 의사를 밝히는 등 대응책 마련에 분주하다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110702.summary_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者申在宇＝曾与唐纳德·特朗普美国总统关系密切、却在中期选举中遭遇猛烈逆风的硅谷大型科技企业，已开始重新调整政治战略。随着民主党预告将掌控国会并加强对人工智能（AI）的监管，加之共和党内部要求与科技行业保持距离的声音日益高涨，这些企业在政治阵营双方之间都面临压力。据英国《金融时报》（FT）当地时间6日报道，人工智能企业正忙于采取应对措施，包括招聘与民主党关系密切的人士，并表达愿意接受监管的立场。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110702.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 신재우 기자 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 밀착했다가 중간선거에서 거센 역풍을 맞은 실리콘밸리의 빅테크 기업들이 정치 전략 재정비에 나섰다. 민주당이 의회를 장악하며 인공지능(AI) 규제 강화를 예고한 데다 공화당 내부에서도 기술 업계와 거리를 둬야 한다는 목소리가 커지면서 정치권 양쪽에서 압박받는 처지가 된 것이다. 6일(현지시간) 영국 일간 파이낸셜타임스(FT)에 따르면 AI 기업들은 민주당과 가까운 인사들을 영입하고 규제 수용 의사를 밝히는 등 대응책 마련에 분주하다. 빅테크 기업들은 중간선거를 맞아 공화당 선거운동 단체에 6억달러(약 8천억원) 이상을 지원했지만, 공화당은 민주당에 상·하원 다수당 지위를 모두 내줬다. 공화당 전략가 브렌던 스타인하우저는 "기술 업계 거물들을 실리콘밸리로 돌려보내야 한다"며 테슬라의 일론 머스크, 엔비디아의 젠슨 황 최고경영자(CEO) 등과 거리를 둬야 한다고 주장했다. 친트럼프 활동가 에이미 크레머도 "우리는 거대 AI 기업의 돈에 의회 다수당 지위를 걸고 도박하면서 정작 우리 유권자들은 무시했다"고 비판했다. 민주당은 내년 1월 새 의회가 출범하면 기술기업 경영진을 의회에 불러 선서 증언을 요구하고, 연방정부와 거래하는 머스크 등의 사업 활동을 조사할 방침이다. 오픈AI는 민주당 척 슈머 상원 원내대표의 딸 제시카 슈머를 영입했고, 메타와 팔란티어도 민주당과 가까운 로비스트 채용에 나섰다. AI 기업들은 '데이터센터'를 '컴퓨팅 캠퍼스'로 바꿔 부르는 방안을 논의하는 한편, 지역 주민들의 반발을 누그러뜨리기 위해 학교 지원과 전력망 투자, 환경 보호 조치 등을 약속하고 있다. 그러나 이 같은 뒤늦은 이미지 개선과 규제 수용 움직임에도 정치권과 시민단체의 불신을 해소하기는 쉽지 않을 것이라는 지적이 나온다. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110702.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者申宰宇报道 = 曾一度与唐纳德·特朗普总统关系密切、却在中期选举中遭遇强劲逆风的硅谷大型科技企业，正着手重整政治战略。随着民主党预告将主导国会并加强对人工智能（AI）的监管，且共和党内部要求与科技行业拉开距离的声音日益壮大，这些企业陷入了来自政治阵营双方的压力。据6日（当地时间）英国《金融时报》报道，人工智能企业正忙于制定应对措施，包括招募与民主党关系密切的人士，并表态愿意接受监管。大型科技企业在中期选举中向共和党的选举活动组织提供了超过6亿美元（约8000亿韩元）的支持，但共和党最终将参众两院的多数党席位都拱手让给了民主党。共和党战略师布伦丹·施泰因豪泽主张，必须让科技界的巨头们回到硅谷，并称应与特斯拉的埃隆·马斯克、英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋等人保持距离。特朗普阵营活动人士艾米·克雷默也批评说：“我们押上国会多数党地位，赌博于巨型人工智能企业的资金，却无视了我们自己的选民。”民主党计划于明年1月新一届国会就任后，要求科技企业高管赴国会宣誓作证，并调查马斯克等与联邦政府开展业务往来的经营活动。OpenAI聘用了民主党参议院院内领袖查克·舒默的女儿杰西卡·舒默，Meta和Palantir也启动了与民主党关系密切的律所招聘。人工智能企业正在讨论把“数据中心”改称“计算园区”，同时为平息当地居民的反对情绪，承诺支持学校、投资电网并采取环境保护措施。然而，有观点指出，即使采取这些姗姗来迟的形象改善措施和接受监管的举动，也难以消除政界和民间团体的不信任。支持人工智能监管的组织Guardrails Alliance负责人肖娜·托马斯表示，由于大型科技企业与政界关系密切，无论它们提出什么法案或政策构想，一开始都会引发抵触情绪，并称：“他们似乎仍未意识到这一点。”本报可通过KakaoTalk的okjebo咨询 <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载和再分发，禁止用于人工智能学习及使用> 2026/11/07 10:54发稿 2026年11月7日10时54分发稿 10月8日举行的“新黄金时代峰会”上，领取特朗普总统授予勋章的特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克、英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋及谷歌联合创始人谢尔盖·布林站在台上的场景 [法新社=韩联社资料照片。禁止转售及数据库收录]

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110702.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者金正진＝共同民主党于7日表示，国民力量反对“操纵起诉特别检察法”，并因此决定走上街头抗议，随后批评称：“究竟是为了什么才走上街头？”代表孙明秀当天在评论文章中表示：“如果国家的侦查权和起诉权因政治目的而被滥用，就会动摇法治主义的根基。必须通过特别检察官的调查彻底查明真相，防止此类事件再次发生。”孙代表还指出，国民力量删除了与特别检察官是否决定继续公诉相关、且曾引发争议的条款，并称：“然而，国民力量却将此事推向‘拯救总统’，甚至走上街头抗议。”他随后向国民力量呼吁：“你们连澄清检察机关滥用职权嫌疑的真相都反对吗？你们是想掩盖国家权力是否因政治目的而被滥用吗？”并敦促：“在回避查明特别检察官查明错误滥用权力真相这一本质的情况下，以政治口水战对国民进行炮轰的行为必须立即停止。”报道请通过KakaoTalk okjebo联系＜版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载・再分发，禁止用于AI学习及使用＞2026/11/07 11:17发稿 2026年11月07日 11时17分发稿

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 法院指示该州须在30天内完成其余村民大会的组建，并自组建之日起5个月内，通过法定三级机制完成整个申请、审理索赔的流程。“很明显，州政府主要应对依据《2006年土地权利法》接收、核实和裁定索赔这一进程的延误负责。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: A bench of justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta constituted the committee, comprising Justice Gavai as chairperson, an officer of the Central Empowered Committee (CEC) and Tamil Nadu’s principal chief conservator of forests, to oversee the determination of claims by forest-dwelling scheduled tribes (FDST) and other traditional forest dwellers (OTFD). The committee will scrutinise the orders passed by competent authorities under the FRA and submit its findings to the court in a sealed cover. The court directed the state to complete the constitution of the remaining Gram Sabhas within 30 days and conclude the entire process of inviting and adjudicating claims through the statutory three-tier mechanism within five months of their constitution. The committee, in turn, has been asked to complete its scrutiny within two months of the expiry of this outer deadline. Criticising the state for its inaction, the bench observed that the process under the FRA had remained uninitiated for years even after an interim stay imposed by the Madras high court was vacated by the Supreme Court in 2016. “Apparently thus, the process under Section 6 was never initiated for years even after the lifting of the stay and seems to have been triggered only after this Court took suo moto cognizance of the prevailing situation,” it said. The bench added that the state appeared to have “woken up” only after the court directed the removal of encroachments from the Srivilliputhur-Megamalai Tiger Reserve and other reserved forests in the Agasthyamalai Biosphere. “It is clear that the State Government is primarily responsible for the delay in the process of receiving, identifying and adjudicating the claims under the FRA, 2006. Before this Court took cognizance of the encroachments in the forest area, even the Gram Sabhas had not been constituted,” said the bench, granting the state what it described as a “last opportunity” to complete the exercise. The committee has been empowered to issue necessary directions to authorities for expeditious disposal of claims. The state will also have to submit monthly progress reports to it. Senior counsel Jaideep Gupta appeared for the state government while senior advocate Sriram Panchu represented the state’s department of social justice. The directions came in proceedings concerning large-scale encroachments in the Agasthyamalai landscape, where the court had, in its May 29 judgment, ordered a structured and time-bound process for eviction, rehabilitation and ecological restoration. The latest proceedings arose from competing claims over the application of the FRA to people residing in or cultivating land in the Megamalai region. While the state argued that claims under the FRA needed to be examined before eviction, the court accepted the amicus curiae and senior advocate K Parmeshwar’s submission that the statutory protection could not be extended indiscriminately to everyone occupying or cultivating forest land. The bench clarified that two categories of occupants identified by the state itself would be excluded from consideration under the Act. These are people cultivating forest land while maintaining only temporary residence within it and those residing outside the forest boundary but cultivating land inside it. The state’s affidavit had identified 4,594 occupants spread across 5,072.64 hectares, of whom 2,643 were engaged in silk cotton cultivation over 3,637.83 hectares. Of these, 1,595 persons were permanently residing in the forest and cultivating land, 232 had temporary residence while cultivating, and 2,767 were residing outside the forest boundary but cultivating within it. The court said the latter two categories could not qualify as FDST or OTFD merely on the basis of cultivation, since the statutory definitions required claimants to primarily reside in and depend on forest land. For OTFDs, the law specifically requires residence and dependence for at least three generations, or 75 years, prior to December 13, 2005. The court also rejected the state’s attempt to justify silk cotton cultivation as a traditional minor forest produce protected under the FRA. It noted that the government had relied on historical cultivation and agricultural records but had failed to produce any specific notification recognising silk cotton as minor forest produce under the Act or any other forest law. Distinguishing between naturally occurring forest produce and commercial cultivation, the bench said the material suggested that silk cotton had been introduced as a planned plantation rather than traditionally collected as minor forest produce. “The concept of planned cultivation of commercial crop is totally contrary to the very concept of a naturally occurring minor forest produce,” said the bench, adding that commercial crop cultivation could not become a recognised forest right to justify continued occupation of reserved forest land. It further asked the CEC to examine the state’s claim that silk cotton qualified as minor forest produce and investigate the circumstances surrounding cultivation by people residing outside the forest boundary, including whether others were financing or facilitating such activity. The matter will next be heard on February 1, 2027, when the court will consider an interim status report
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 前首席大法官加瓦伊将主持审查泰米尔纳德邦森林权利主张的专门小组
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 由Vikram Nath和Sandeep Mehta法官组成的合议庭组建了一个委员会，负责监督认定森林居住的列入种姓部落（FDST）和其他传统森林居民（OTFD）权利申请事项。委员会由Gavai法官担任主席，成员包括中央授权委员会（CEC）的一名官员和泰米尔纳德邦首席森林保护官。委员会将审查主管机关依据《森林权利法》（FRA）作出的命令，并以密封方式向法院提交调查结果。法院指示该邦在30天内完成其余村民大会的组建，并在组建后5个月内，通过法定三级机制完成权利申请受理和裁决的全部流程。委员会则应在这个最终期限届满后2个月内完成审查。合议庭批评该邦不作为，指出即便最高法院于2016年撤销Madras高等法院实施的临时中止令，FRA下的相关程序仍多年未曾启动。合议庭称：“显然，即使中止令被解除，《森林权利法》第6条下的程序仍多年没有启动，似乎只是在本法院依职权审理当前局势后才启动。”合议庭补充说，只有在法院下令清除Srivilliputhur-Megamalai虎保护区和Agasthyamalai生物圈其他保护森林中的侵占行为后，该邦才似乎‘醒悟过来’。合议庭说：“显然，邦政府应对依据《2006年森林权利法》接收、识别和裁决权利申请的延误负主要责任。在本法院关注森林区域侵占问题之前，甚至村民大会都尚未组建。”合议庭给予该邦其所称的‘最后机会’，要求其完成这项工作。委员会已获授权向有关机关发布必要指示，以迅速处理权利申请。该邦还必须每月向委员会提交进展报告。资深律师Jaideep Gupta代表邦政府出庭，资深律师Sriram Panchu代表该邦社会正义部门。这些指示是在审理Agasthyamalai地区大规模侵占问题的案件中作出的。法院曾在5月29日的判决中，要求采取结构化且设有期限的程序，以进行清退、安置和生态修复。此次审理源于就FRA是否适用于居住在Megamalai地区或在当地耕种土地的人群而提出的相互竞争的权利主张。该邦主张，在清退之前应先审查FRA下的权利申请；法院接受了法庭之友及资深律师K Parmeshwar的意见，即不得将该法规定的保护不加区别地延伸至所有占用或耕种森林土地的人。合议庭明确指出，该邦自行确定的两类占用者不会被纳入该法下的审查范围：一类是在森林土地上耕种、但仅在林内临时居住的人；另一类是在森林边界以外居住、但在森林内耕种土地的人。该邦的宣誓书列明，共有4,594名占用者分布于5,072.64公顷土地上，其中2,643人在3,637.83公顷土地上从事木棉种植。在这些人中，1,595人长期居住在森林内并耕种土地，232人在耕种期间临时居住，另有2,767人在森林边界以外居住、但在森林内耕种。法院表示，后两类人不能仅凭耕种行为就取得FDST或OTFD资格，因为法律对权利申请人的法定定义要求其主要居住并依赖森林土地。对于OTFD，法律明确要求其在2005年12月13日之前已经居住并依赖森林至少三代，或达75年。法院还驳回了该邦试图将木棉种植认定为FRA所保护的传统 minor forest produce 的主张。合议庭指出，政府虽引用了历史耕种和农业记录，却未能提供任何具体通知，承认木棉属于该法或其他森林法律规定的 minor forest produce。在区分天然生长的森林产品与商业种植时，合议庭表示，相关材料表明，木棉是作为规划种植园引入的，而非传统采集的 minor forest produce。合议庭说：“有计划地种植商业作物这一概念，与天然生长的 minor forest produce 这一概念完全相悖。”此外，商业作物的种植不能成为一项公认森林权利，以证明继续占用保护森林土地的正当性。法院还要求CEC审查该邦关于木棉属于 minor forest produce 的主张，并调查居住在森林边界以外的人从事种植活动的相关情况，包括是否有人为该活动提供资金或便利。案件将于2027年2月1日再次开庭，届时法院将审议一份中期进展报告

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 印度与欧盟（EU）已就新德里加入“地平线欧洲”计划完成谈判。该计划是欧盟价值935亿欧元的旗舰研究与创新计划，谈判赶在印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪预计访问布鲁塞尔、正式敲定印欧贸易协议之前完成。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: India and the European Union (EU) have concluded negotiations on New Delhi’s association with Horizon Europe, the EU’s €93.5-billion flagship research and innovation programme, ahead of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s expected visit to Brussels for the conclusion of the India-EU trade deal. The conclusion of the negotiations between the Indian side and the European Commission is an “important step” forward for EU-India relations, strengthening scientific cooperation, creating new opportunities in research, and deepening the bilateral strategic partnership, the Commission said on Friday. This also clears the way for the signing of the association agreement, subject to completion of necessary procedures by both sides. Association is envisaged for January 2027, the Commission said. India’s association will open up more opportunities for researchers, research organisations and businesses across Europe to collaborate with Indian partners and build scientific and technological links. Once the agreement is signed and necessary procedures are completed by both sides, Indian researchers and organisations will be able to receive funding directly from Horizon Europe and lead collaborative projects under its Pillar II on “Global Challenges and European Industrial Competitiveness”. This is the largest part of the programme, which funds collaborative, multi-national research and innovation projects tackling societal and technological issues such as health, digital, industry, space, climate, energy and bioeconomy. Indian and European partners will be able to pool expertise, develop technologies and address shared challenges. The Indian PM is expected to travel to Brussels in mid-December for the formal signing of the India-EU free trade agreement, negotiations for which were concluded in January. The trade deal is expected to enter into force next year after it is ratified by the European Parliament. Association with Horizon Europe is the closest form of cooperation offered by the EU to countries outside the grouping under the programme. This allows organisations in associated countries to participate on equal terms with EU counterparts in parts of Horizon Europe covered by the agreement. In return, associated countries contribute financially to the programme. “The agreement opens new opportunities for our businesses. Horizon Europe will help our researchers and innovators work together on what comes next. We want Europe and India to be partners in developing the technologies that will shape our future,” said EU commissioner for startups, research and innovation, Ekaterina Zaharieva. Also Read I Making the India-EU trade deal work for Tiruppur and Moradabad India and the EU launched exploratory discussions on Horizon Europe in February, followed by formal negotiations in July. India-EU scientific cooperation builds on the Agreement for Scientific and Technological Cooperation, signed in 2001 and renewed until 2030. Research and innovation are an integral part of the Joint India-EU Comprehensive Strategic Agenda to 2030, adopted at the India-EU Summit in January. The partnership has been strengthened through the bilateral Trade and Technology Council, which facilitates collaboration in key digital areas such as artificial intelligence , digital public infrastructure, semiconductors, high-performance computing, digital skills, and sixth generation wireless telecommunications. India and the EU took a further step in collaboration on digital skills through the launch of the first-ever European Legal Gateway Office in India in February, aimed at facilitating safe and legal mobility to EU states in the ICT sector. International cooperation is central to Horizon Europe, which runs from 2021 to 2027 and has a budget of €93.5 billion. A total of 23 non-EU countries are currently associated with Horizon Europe, including Canada, Egypt, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand, Norway, Switzerland, Ukraine and the UK. Negotiations for association have also been concluded with Australia
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 印度与欧盟结束关键科学合作计划的谈判
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 印度与欧盟就新德里参与“地平线欧洲”计划达成协议。“地平线欧洲”是欧盟预算达€93.5 billion的旗舰研究与创新计划，此次谈判在印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪预计访问布鲁塞尔、见证印度—欧盟贸易协议敲定之前完成。欧盟委员会周五表示，印度与欧盟委员会结束谈判，是推动欧盟—印度关系向前发展的“重要一步”，将加强科学合作、创造新的研究机遇，并深化双边战略伙伴关系。这也为签署参与协议铺平了道路，但双方仍须完成必要程序。欧盟委员会表示，计划于2027年1月实现参与。印度参与后，欧洲各地的研究人员、研究机构和企业在与印度伙伴开展合作及建立科学与技术联系方面，将获得更多机会。协议签署且双方完成必要程序后，印度研究人员和机构将能够直接从“地平线欧洲”获得资金，并牵头实施其第二支柱“全球挑战与欧洲产业竞争力”框架下的合作项目。这是该计划中规模最大的组成部分，为应对健康、数字、产业、太空、气候、能源和生物经济等社会与技术问题的跨国协作研究与创新项目提供资金。印度与欧洲伙伴将能够汇集专长、开发技术并应对共同挑战。预计印度总理将于12月中旬赴布鲁塞尔，正式签署印度—欧盟自由贸易协定；相关谈判已于1月结束。贸易协议经欧洲议会批准后，预计明年生效。参与“地平线欧洲”是欧盟向该计划框架外国家提供的最深入合作形式。关联国家可在协议涵盖的“地平线欧洲”部分，与欧盟 counterparts 平等参与。作为回报，关联国家需向该计划提供资金。欧盟负责初创企业、研究与创新的委员叶卡捷琳娜·扎哈列娃说：“该协议为我们的企业开辟了新机遇。‘地平线欧洲’将帮助我们的研究人员和创新者共同探索未来。我们希望欧洲和印度成为伙伴，共同开发塑造我们未来的技术。”另请参阅《我：让印度—欧盟贸易协议为蒂鲁普尔和莫拉达巴德发挥作用》。2月，印度与欧盟启动了“地平线欧洲”的探索性讨论，随后于7月展开正式谈判。印度—欧盟科学合作以2001年签署并延续至2030年的《科学技术合作协议》为基础。研究与创新是1月印度—欧盟峰会通过的《面向2030年的印度—欧盟综合战略议程》不可分割的一部分。双方通过双边贸易与技术理事会加强伙伴关系，该理事会推动人工智能、数字公共基础设施、半导体、高性能计算、数字技能和第六代无线电信等关键数字领域的合作。2月，首个欧洲法律门户办事处在印度启动，双方借此在数字技能领域进一步合作，旨在促进信息通信技术行业人员安全、合法地流动至欧盟成员国。国际合作是“地平线欧洲”的核心。该计划实施周期为2021年至2027年，预算为€93.5 billion。目前共有23个非欧盟国家参与“地平线欧洲”，包括加拿大、埃及、日本、韩国、新西兰、挪威、瑞士、乌克兰和英国。澳大利亚也已完成参与谈判

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110702.summary_zh: （墨西哥城=韩联社）特派员宋光虎＝当地时间6日，因弹劾案而事实上结束政治生涯的圣地亚哥·佩尼亚（48岁）总统是南美“蓝色潮汐”（右翼执政浪潮）的主要政治人物之一。他在唐纳德·特朗普第二届政府上台前的2023年4月当选总统，并于同年8月就任，充当“蓝色潮汐”的推动力量。他就任仅9个月后，阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱接过了接力棒。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110702.body: (멕시코시티=연합뉴스) 송광호 특파원 = 6일(현지시간) 파면으로 정치 인생을 사실상 마감한 산티아고 페냐(48) 파라과이 대통령은 남미 블루타이드(우파 집권 물결)의 주요 정치인 중 한 명이다. 도널드 트럼프 2기 행정부가 출범하기 전인 2023년 4월 대통령에 당선돼 그해 8월 취임하며 블루타이드의 견인차 구실을 했다. 그가 취임한 지 넉 달 뒤 아르헨티나의 하비에르 밀레이 대통령이 바통을 이어받았다. 처음부터 우파 정치인은 아니었다. 국제통화기금(IMF)에서 근무한 경제통으로 야당이자 중도좌파인 정통급진자유당(PLRA) 출신이었다. 우파의 길을 걷기 시작한 것은 약 70년간 파라과이를 지배한 집권 여당의 계파 수장인 오라시오 카르테스 전 대통령(2013∼2018)이 그를 2016년 여권으로 스카우트하면서다. 카르테스는 그를 재무 장관으로 발탁하며 중용했다. 그는 카르테스의 물밑 지원 속에 콜로라도당의 대권후보로 도약했으며 2023년 대통령에 당선됐다. 당적을 옮긴 지 7년 만에 거둔 고속 승진이었다. 한때 '카르테스의 꼭두각시'라는 비판을 받았으나 대통령이 된 이후부터는 독자노선을 걷기 시작했다. 카리스마 넘치는 그는 해외를 수없이 방문하며 외교 정상들을 만나고 투자자들을 유치했다. 특히 트럼프 2기가 시작되면서 우파 색채를 강하게 드러내며 워싱턴의 주목을 받았다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 지난 2월 워싱턴 정상회의에서 그를 "젊고 잘생긴 친구"라며 치켜세우기도 했다. 스페인어권 매체 인포바에 따르면 페냐는 미국의 지원 속에 자신의 세력을 강화하면서 당내 거두인 카르테스와 조금씩 사이가 틀어지기 시작했다. 특히 콜로라도당이 10월 지방 선거에서 주요 도시인 아순시온과 시우다드델에스테에서 패배하자 그는 당 대표인 카르테스를 몰아세운 것으로 전해졌다. 페냐는 자신의 심복을 앉히기 위해 카르테스에게 당권에서 물러날 것을 요구했으며 카르테스는 우에노 은행 사태를 언급하며 맞받아쳤다는 후문이다. 집권 콜로라도당이 분열로 치닫는 상황에서 지방선거 한 달 만에 결국 우에노 은행 사건이 터졌고, 그로부터 나흘 만에 페냐 대통령은 파면됐다. 결정타는 카르테스가 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 올린 한 문장이었다. "콜로라도당의 대표로서 우리는 공공자금, 민간자금, 그리고 은퇴자들의 돈이 강탈당하는 편에 서지 않을 것이다. 우리는 국민과 콜로라도당이 지켜온 가치를 먼저 생각해야 한다." 카르테스가 이같이 선언하자, 애초 야당 의원만 찬성했던 탄핵안에 여당 의원들이 가세했다. 페냐 대통령은 상·하원 양원 의원들의 압도적인 찬성 속에 대통령 직위에서 파면된 것은 물론, 경찰의 체포영장 집행으로 피의자 신세로 전락했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/07 10:58 송고 2026년11월07일 10시58분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110702.body_zh: （墨西哥城=韩联社）驻外记者宋光浩=6日（当地时间）因弹劾而事实上结束政治生涯的圣地亚哥·佩尼亚（48岁）总统，是南美“蓝潮”（右翼执政浪潮）的主要政治人物之一。他于2023年4月，即唐纳德·特朗普第二届政府成立前当选总统，并在当年8月就职，充当了“蓝潮”的牵引车。他就职仅九个月后，阿根廷的哈维尔·米莱总统接过了接力棒。他起初并非右翼政客。他曾在国际货币基金组织（IMF）任职，是经济学家，出身于作为反对党且属中左翼的正统급진自由党（PLRA）。他开始走上右翼道路，始于执掌巴拉圭约70年的执政党党羽、派系首领奥拉西奥·卡特斯前总统（2013∼2018）于2016年利用护照相中他的时候。卡特斯任命他为财政部长并委以重任。在卡特斯的暗中支持下，他跃升为科罗拉多党总统候选人，并于2023年当选总统。这是他转换政党后仅7年便实现的高速晋升。他一度受到“卡特斯傀儡”的批评，但自从成为总统后，便开始走独立路线。极富魅力的他走访海外，会见各国政要并吸引投资者。特に是在特朗普第二届政府开始后，他鲜明地展现出右翼倾向，引起华盛顿关注。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普今年2月在华盛顿峰会上还称赞他是“年轻英俊的朋友”。据西班牙语媒体Infobae报道，佩尼亚在美国支持下壮大自身势力，同时开始与党内元老卡特斯逐渐产生嫌隙。特别是科罗拉多党在10月地方选举中败于阿松西翁和苏亚德德尔埃斯特等主要城市后，据传他开始向党首卡特斯施压。据说，为让心腹坐稳党内位置，佩尼亚要求卡特斯退出党首职位，卡特斯则提及Uneo银行事件予以反击。就在执政的科罗拉多党陷入分裂之际，地方选举一个月后，Uneo银行事件终于爆发；又过了两天，佩尼亚总统便遭弹劾。导火索是卡特斯在X（原Twitter）上发布的一句话：“作为科罗拉多党的代表，我们不会站在公共资金、私人资金以及退休者钱财遭掠夺的一方。我们必须首先考虑国家和科罗拉多党所守护的价值。”卡特斯作出这一声明后，最初仅有反对党议员赞成的弹劾案得到了执政党议员加入。在参众两院议员压倒性赞成之下，佩尼亚总统不仅被弹劾免去总统职务，还因警方执行逮捕令而沦为嫌疑人。报道请通过KakaoTalk okjebo发送 <版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、再发布及用于AI学习和应用> 2026/11/07 10:58发稿 2026年11月07日10时58分发稿

Unlock these with Subscription India and the European Union have concluded negotiations on New Delhi’s association with a Euro 93.5 billion flagship research and innovation programme, paving the way for expanded collaboration under their broader strategic partnership. The decision comes weeks before India and the 27-nation bloc are set to seal a landmark free trade agreement — billed as the “mother of all deals” — to create a market of two billion people. The European Commission and India have successfully concluded negotiations on New Delhi’s association with the Horizon Europe programme, the EU said. This marks an important step forward for EU-India relations, strengthening scientific cooperation, creating new opportunities in research, and deepening the strategic partnership, it said. India’s association with the Horizon programme is seen as part of the comprehensive strategic agenda of the two sides for the next five years. For researchers, businesses and research organisations across Europe, India’s association will open up more opportunities to collaborate with Indian partners and build lasting scientific and technological links, the EU said. Once the agreement is signed and the necessary procedures are completed on both sides, researchers and organisations in India will be able to receive funding directly from Horizon Europe and lead collaborative projects under its Pillar II: ‘Global Challenges and European Industrial Competitiveness’, it said. This is the largest part of the programme which funds collaborative, multi-national research and innovation projects tackling societal and technological issues, such as health, digital, industry, space, climate, energy, and bioeconomy. The EU said the move will create new opportunities for European and Indian partners to pool expertise, develop technologies and address shared challenges. Association is the closest form of cooperation offered by the EU to non-EU countries under Horizon Europe. It allows organisations in associated countries to participate on equal terms with their EU counterparts in the parts of the programme covered by the agreement. In return, associated countries contribute financially to the programme. The successful conclusion of negotiations clears the way for the signature of the association agreement, subject to the completion of the necessary procedures on both sides. The two sides are likely to sign the formal agreement in January. India and the EU had launched the exploratory discussions on the Horizon programme in February 2026, and formal negotiations began in July. EU-India scientific cooperation builds on the agreement for scientific and technological cooperation, signed in 2001 and renewed until 2030. Research and innovation also form an integral part of the Joint EU-India Comprehensive Strategic Agenda towards 2030, adopted at the summit talks between the two sides in New Delhi on January 27. The partnership has been strengthened through the EU-India Trade and Technology Council, which facilitates collaboration on key digital areas such as artificial intelligence, digital public infrastructure, semiconductors, high-performance computing, digital skills and the sixth generation of wireless telecommunications. The EU and India took a further step in collaboration on digital skills through the launch of the first-ever European Legal Gateway Office in India last February, aiming to facilitate safe, legal and well-informed mobility to the EU in the ICT sector. Horizon Europe runs from 2021 to 2027, with a budget of 93.5 billion euro. International cooperation is central to the programme, bringing together expertise and resources to advance scientific excellence and innovation. Currently, 23 non-EU countries are associated with Horizon Europe. They are Albania, Armenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Canada, Egypt, the Faroe Islands, Georgia, Iceland, Israel, Japan, Korea, Kosovo, Moldova, Montenegro, New Zealand, North Macedonia, Norway, Serbia, Switzerland, Türkiye, Tunisia, Ukraine and the United Kingdom. The India and EU ties have witnessed a major upswing in the last few years. The two sides are set to sign the free trade deal next month. Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. https://punchng.com/nigerian-wins-us-fel.body: An Interdisciplinary Humanities doctoral candidate at the University of California, Omowumi Omole, has been awarded the 2026 Dean’s Dissertation Fellowship from the School of Social Sciences, Humanities and Arts. The fellowship, valued at $27,000, will support her dissertation fieldwork and data collection in Lagos, Nigeria. In a statement made available to Diaspora Tales, the fellowship is designed to help doctoral candidates make steady progress on their dissertations. “It releases Omole from her teaching responsibilities for the Fall 2026 semester so that she can devote her full attention to research,” it stated. “Omole’s dissertation examines how Pentecostal marriage teachings shape women’s political subjectivity, particularly their views on laws meant to protect them from violence. “Her work looks closely at the debate over the non-criminalisation of marital rape in Nigeria, a debate that gained fresh attention after the widely publicised death of gospel singer Osinachi Nwachukwu.” Her ethnographic study follows women through marriage classes at two Lagos churches and examines churchgoers’ attitudes towards issues such as bodily autonomy and reproductive rights. Omole has also conducted research among Nigerian diaspora congregations in Dallas, Texas, and plans to continue the study at a church in Houston, to see how the same teachings are embodied abroad. Unlock these with Subscription The Delhi High Court on Friday (November 6, 2026) directed the removal of several social media posts and videos by Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) allegedly depicting Chief Minister Rekha Gupta in a defamatory and demeaning manner through AI-generated images and deepfake videos. Justice Manoj Jain observed that the “offensive portrayal of the Chief Minister, with the assistance of AI-generated videos, hurting her very dignity can be, by no stretch of imagination, said to be in the realm of permissible political satire”. The order was passed in a defamation suit filed by Ms. Gupta against the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), seeking a to restrain them from publishing, circulating or disseminating allegedly defamatory AI-generated content. According to the plea, several AI-generated videos, images and posters published through AAP’s official and verified social media accounts portrayed Ms. Gupta as a liquor vendor, hawker and delivery agent, besides depicting her as the head of a fictitious ‘Har Har Rekha or Ghar Ghar Theka Yojana’. The CM, in her plea, said that the content created a misleading impression of her involvement in selling and serving liquor. One video allegedly showed her serving drinks to men at night, while another featured AI-generated depictions of both the Chief Minister and Deputy Chief Minister pouring liquor and ice cubes. “The video-images look so real and near-perfect imitation,” the plea said. The Court noted that one of the videos, posted on X on November 4, had reportedly garnered around 75,000 views, 1,600 likes and 470 reposts when its screenshot was captured. “Satire may though hurt conscience of any individual but it cannot be permitted to create irreparable wound on someone’s dignity. In the garb of freedom of speech and expression and under the disguise of humour and satire, no one can be permitted to be reduced to an object of ridicule and insult,” the court said. It further noted that while holding public office invites greater scrutiny, an individual’s dignity cannot be compromised. Referring to earlier decisions, including the Raghav Chadha case, the Court observed that until appropriate legislation regulates AI-generated content, courts have a duty to examine whether its use infringes an individual’s right to dignity. The court also issued notices to all defendants, including AAP, while posting the case for further hearing on December 4. Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. 德里高等法院于2026年11月6日（星期五）下令删除多条社交媒体帖子和视频 allegedly以诽谤性和贬损性的方式描绘首席部长Rekha Gupta，这些内容通过人工智能生成的图像和深度伪造视频呈现。法官Manoj Jain指出，在人工智能生成视频的辅助下，对首席部长作出“伤害其人格尊严的冒犯性描绘，无论如何都不能说属于可允许的政治讽刺范畴”。

法院在Ms. Gupta针对人民党（AAP）提起的诽谤诉讼中作出该项命令。Ms. Gupta请求法院禁止该党发布、传播或散布据称具有诽谤性的人工智能生成内容。

据诉状称，人民党官方及经过认证的社交媒体账号发布了多段人工智能生成的视频、图像和海报，将Ms. Gupta描绘成酒类小贩、街头小贩和配送员，还描绘她是虚构的“Har Har Rekha or Ghar Ghar Theka Yojana”负责人。

首席部长在诉状中表示，这些内容使外界产生她参与销售和供应酒类的错误印象。其中一段视频据称显示她在夜间向男子递送酒水，另一段视频则出现了首席部长和副首席部长倒酒及加入冰块的生成图像。诉状称：“这些视频图像看起来极为真实，几乎达到完美仿真的程度。”

法院指出，其中一段于11月4日发布在X上的视频，据报道在截图留存时已获得约75,000次浏览、1,600次点赞和470次转帖。

法院表示：“讽刺虽然可能伤害任何人的良知，但绝不能被允许对某人的尊严造成不可弥补的伤害。任何人都不应当以言论和表达自由为外衣、以幽默和讽刺为伪装，而被贬低为嘲笑和侮辱的对象。”

法院进一步指出，担任公职固然意味着要接受更严格的审视，但个人尊严不能因此受到损害。法院援引包括Raghav Chadha案在内的既往裁决指出，在适当的立法对人工智能生成内容作出规范之前，法院有责任审查此类内容的使用是否侵犯个人的尊严权。

法院还向包括人民党在内的所有被告发出通知，并将案件排定于12月4日继续审理。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110616.body: 주휴스턴 총영사를 지낸 저자가 글로벌 공급망 재편과 미국 제조업의 변화를 분석하고 한국 기업의 대응 방향을 제시한 책. 저자는 경제 외교와 산업 현장 방문 경험 등을 바탕으로 세계 경제의 구조적 전환 속에서 한국 기업이 미국을 어떻게 이해하고 접근해야 하는지 살펴본다. 그는 미국을 바라보는 관점의 전환을 촉구한다. 제품을 판매하는 시장을 넘어 자본과 기술, 인재와 생산 기반이 연결되는 산업 플랫폼으로 접근해야 한다는 것이다. 책은 미국 제조업의 귀환, 산업 입지의 이동, 현지 진입 전략 등 국제 정세 분석과 기업의 실천 과제를 연결해 입체적으로 설명한다. 특히 텍사스의 산업 현장을 통해 반도체, 인공지능(AI), 바이오, 우주산업이 연결되는 구조적 변화를 구체적으로 보여준다. 북한과 중국 국경의 길이는 1천400㎞로 남북한 군사분계선 248㎞보다 5배 이상 길다. 북·중 국경은 북한의 변화를 읽을 수 있는 중요한 관찰 지점이기도 하지만, 휴전선에 비해 크게 주목받지 못했다. KBS 특파원으로 중국에서 7년 넘게 근무한 저자는 압록강에서 두만강까지 북·중 국경을 물길과 감시망을 중심으로 살펴본다. 책은 압록강과 두만강에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지, 교량과 철도는 어떻게 변하는지, 강과 섬의 경계는 어떻게 형성되는지, 그 공간에서 중국, 북한, 러시아가 어떤 이해관계를 만들어가는지 조명한다. 압록강과 두만강의 준설 작업과 국경 지역 홍수, 마시도에서 불거진 북·중 영토 갈등, 신압록강대교와 두만강 통관 벨트 등 북·중 접경 인프라와 단둥을 비롯한 주요 접경 도시의 다양한 활동과 변화를 담았다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/07 08:20 송고 2026년11월07일 08시20분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110616.title_zh: 新刊：美国产业重组之际，韩国企业的战略是“再次走向美国”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110616.body_zh: 曾在休斯敦担任总领事的作者撰写的著作，分析了全球供应链重组和美国制造业的变化，并提出韩国企业的应对方向。作者以经济外交和走访产业现场等经验为基础，考察在世界经济结构转型之际，韩国企业应如何理解和接触美国，同时呼吁转换看待美国的视角。书中主张，对美国的接触不应局限于产品销售市场，而应将其视为资本、技术、人才与生产基础相互联结的产业平台。全书将美国制造业回归、产业区位转移、当地进入战略等国际局势分析与企业的实践课题相结合，进行立体阐释。尤其是通过得克萨斯州的产业现场，具体展示半导体、人工智能（AI）、生物技术和航天产业相互联结的结构性变化。朝鲜与中国边界全长1,400千米，是朝韩军事分界线248千米的5倍多。朝鲜与中国边境也是观察朝鲜变化的重要窗口，但与停战线相比受到的关注明显较少。作者作为KBS特派记者在中国工作7年多，以水域和监视网络为主线，从鸭绿江到图们江考察朝鲜与中国边境。全书阐释鸭绿江和图们江沿岸正在发生什么、桥梁和铁路如何变化、河流与岛屿的边界如何形成，以及中国、朝鲜和俄罗斯如何在当地构建利益关系。书中收录了鸭绿江和图们江的疏浚工程、边境地区洪灾、从马蹄岛浮出水面的朝鲜与中国领土争端，以及新鸭绿江大桥、图们江跨境运输带等朝鲜与中国接壤基础设施和丹东等主要边境城市的各种活动与变化。报道可通过KakaoTalk的okjebo查阅。<著作权(c) 联合新闻，未经许可禁止转载或再发布，禁止用于人工智能学习与应用> 2026/11/07 08:20发稿，2026年11月7日08时20分发稿。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026100619.body: 1958년 프랑스의 샤를 드골 대통령 면전에 던진 이 단호한 선언은 서부 아프리카 독립운동의 거대한 불씨가 되었다. 프랑스의 제국주의에 정면으로 맞서 기니의 즉각적인 독립을 쟁취한 인물, 아흐메드 세쿠 투레(1922~1984) 기니 초대 대통령은 아프리카 민족주의 역사에서 가장 강렬한 족적을 남긴 지도자 중 한 명으로 꼽힌다. 1922년 기니 중부 파라나에서 태어난 세쿠 투레는 19세기 프랑스 식민 침략에 맞서 싸운 위대한 저항군 지도자 사모리 투레의 후손으로 알려져 있다. 그는 우체국 직원 등으로 일하며 노동조합 활동에 투신했다. 탁월한 연설 능력과 강력한 카리스마를 바탕으로 기니 노동운동과 민족주의 진영의 핵심 지도자로 부상했다. 당시 드골 프랑스 대통령은 아프리카 식민지국들에 완전 독립 대신 '프랑스 공동체' 내의 자치국으로 남을 것을 종용했다. 대부분의 프랑스어권 아프리카 지도자들이 경제적 지원 중단을 우려해 이를 수용했지만, 세쿠 투레는 단호히 거부했다. 그해 9월 28일 실시된 투표에서 기니 국민은 95%의 압도적인 반대표를 던졌고, 10월 2일 기니는 프랑스어권 아프리카 국가 중 최초로 완전 독립을 선포했다. 기니에 주둔하던 프랑스 관리와 기술자들을 즉각 철수시키며 전화선과 발전소 등 기반 시설을 파괴했고, 심지어 관공서의 전구와 행정 서류, 의약품까지 모조리 파기하거나 챙겨서 떠났다. 신생 독립국 기니를 철저히 붕괴시켜 다른 식민지국에 본보기를 보여주겠다는 의도였다. 그러나 세쿠 투레는 굴복하지 않았다. 서방의 지원이 끊기자 그는 옛소련, 중국 등 공산권 국가들과 손을 잡고 위기를 돌파했다. 가나의 콰메 은크루마 등과 함께 범(凡)아프리카주의 운동을 주도하며 아프리카의 완전한 해방을 역설했다. 대륙 전체의 독립을 상징하는 영웅으로 추앙받았다. 대신 그는 북한의 김일성 주석과 이념적으로 깊이 교감하며 각별한 관계를 맺었다. 세쿠 투레는 여러 차례 평양을 방문했고, 북한은 기니에 농업 기술과 무기를 지원하는 한편 수도 코나크리에 대통령궁을 비롯한 대형 건축물을 지어주며 밀월 관계를 유지했다. 독립 영웅이라는 빛나는 수식어 이면에는 짙은 그림자도 존재한다. 반프랑스 투쟁 과정에서 굳어진 특유의 강경함은 집권 후 철권통치로 변질했다. 그는 1984년 심장 질환으로 미국에서 사망할 때까지 26년간 장기 집권하며 야당을 불법화하고 수많은 정치적 반대파를 무자비하게 숙청했다. 악명 높은 '부아로 수용소'에서는 아프리카단결기구(OAU·현 아프리카연합(AU)의 전신) 초대 사무총장을 지낸 디알로 텔리를 비롯해 수만 명의 지식인과 정치인들이 고문당하거나 목숨을 잃었다. 또한 사회주의식 계획경제의 실패와 폐쇄적인 정책으로 인해 기니는 풍부한 천연자원을 보유하고도 아프리카 최빈국 중 하나로 전락하는 뼈아픈 대가를 치러야 했다. 외세의 억압에 굴하지 않고 아프리카인의 자존심을 지켜낸 불세출의 독립 영웅, 그리고 권력에 취해 국가 경제와 인권을 짓밟은 철권 독재자. 세쿠 투레의 극단적인 두 얼굴은 식민 통치의 상흔과 냉전의 소용돌이 속에서 아프리카 신생 독립국들이 겪어야 했던 가혹한 현대사를 고스란히 투영하고 있다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/07 08:00 송고 2026년11월07일 08시00분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026100619.body_zh: 1958年在法国总统夏尔·戴高乐面前大胆宣读的这份坚定宣言，成为西非独立运动的一股巨大火种。阿赫迈德·塞库·图雷（1922—1984）是几内亚首任总统。他敢于正面对抗法国殖民主义，为几内亚赢得立即独立，被列为非洲民族主义历史上留下最鲜明印记的领袖之一。塞库·图雷于1922年出生在几内亚中部的法拉纳，据知是19世纪抵抗法国殖民入侵的伟大抗军领袖萨莫里·图雷的后裔。他曾从事邮政职员等工作，并投身工会活动，凭借出色的演讲能力和强大个人魅力，成为几内亚劳工运动和民族主义阵营的核心领袖。当时，法国总统戴高乐鼓吹非洲殖民地不要完全独立，而应作为“法兰西共同体”内的自治领地保留下来。多数法语非洲领导人担心经济援助中断，接受了这一主张，但塞库·图雷坚决拒绝。9月28日举行的投票中，几内亚国民以95%的压倒性票数表示反对；10月2日，几内亚成为法语非洲国家中第一个宣布完全独立的国家。他立即撤走在几内亚驻留的法国行政人员和技术人员，破坏电话线和发电厂等基础设施，甚至将办公室的灯泡、行政文件和药品等一并毁掉或装走，企图彻底破坏新生的独立国家几内亚，为其他殖民地作出示范。然而，塞库·图雷并未屈服。西方援助中断后，他同旧苏联、中国等共产主义国家携手合作，突破危机。他与加纳的夸梅·恩克鲁玛等人共同推动泛非主义运动，主张非洲彻底解放，因而被誉为象征整个大陆独立的英雄。他还与朝鲜的金日成主席在意识形态上产生深切共鸣，并建立了特殊关系。塞库·图雷多次访问平壤；朝鲜向几内亚提供农业技术和武器，并承建包括首都科纳克里总统府在内的大型建筑，两国维持着密切关系。在“独立英雄”这一耀眼称号背后，也笼罩着深重阴影。反抗法国的斗争中形成的特有时强硬，在执政后蜕变为铁腕统治。他长期执政26年，期间将反对党非法化，无情清洗众多政治异见者，直至1984年在美国因心脏病去世。恶名昭彰的“博瓦罗集中营”关押过包括曾任非洲统一组织（OAU，现为非盟联盟（AU）前身）首任秘书长的迪亚洛·泰利在内，数万名知识分子和政治家遭受酷刑或丧命。此外，由于社会主义式计划经济失败和封闭政策，几内亚尽管拥有丰富天然气资源，仍沦为非洲最贫困国家之一，付出了沉痛代价。他是不向外来压迫屈服、维护非洲人自尊的杰出独立英雄，也是被权力蒙蔽、践踏国家经济与人权的铁腕独裁者。塞库·图雷极端的两面性，完整映照出非洲新生独立国家在殖民统治创伤与冷战漩涡中所经历的残酷现代史。稿件来自KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 联合新闻，禁止擅自转载或再分发，禁止用于AI学习及运用>，2026年11月7日08:00发布

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110613.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者金泰宗＝韩国股市持续疲软并近日大幅下挫，个人投资者进一步扩大了买入美国股票的规模。韩国证券结算院证券信息门户Save Data于7日公布的数据称，截至查询日，过去2日至5日（2日至5日）西方“蚂蚁”买入美国股票的金额为19.611亿美元（2.5865万亿韩元）。这一规模与去年8月整月的净买入额（19.6234亿美元）相当，约为9月净买入额（10.0128亿美元）的两倍，单周买入规模便超过此前一个月的水平。与去年10月净买入额（54.2312亿美元）相比，约占35%。西方“蚂蚁”去年4月和5月曾配合政府推动资金回流韩国股市的政策，分别净卖出4.6893亿美元和9.3977亿美元的美国股票；但去年6月转为净买入后，近期持续扩大增持规模。上个月净买入额一度创下11个月以来的最高纪录。同期，个人投资者在韩国股票市场的净买入额为3.9万亿韩元，个人投资者在韩国和美国股市的投资规模差距正在缩小。这主要是因为韩国综合股价指数未能延续上半年的涨势，连续数月呈现疲软的下行曲线，近期又出现大幅下跌。此外，韩元兑美元汇率一度突破1500韩元，近期回落至1300韩元中段，为投资美国股市创造了有利环境。进入11月以来，买入最多的美国股票无疑是Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares（SOXL），买入金额达13.0835亿美元，将净买入总额中的68%投入了美国半导体指数3倍杠杆上市指数基金（ETF）。Alphabet净买入4.8033亿美元，跟踪纳斯达克100指数单日收益率3倍的ETF（PROSHARES ULTRAPRO QQQ）也获得1.8772亿美元买入。据韩国金融投资协会统计，截至5日，投资者预缴金为88.5338万亿韩元，自上月13日以来近一个月一直低于100万亿韩元。2日至6日资金流入最多的ETF是TIGER 200，流入资金达2000亿韩元；KODEZX KOSDAQ150杠杆和TIGER CD利率投资KIS（合成）也分别获得1444亿韩元和1201亿韩元资金流入。报道称，可在KakaoTalk上向“okjebo”发送消息。（版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用）2026年11月7日08:00发布
