https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: It sets out systematic plans for continuing to exercise full and rigorous self-governance of the Party on the new journey in the new era, providing a strong political guarantee for advancing the great cause of building a strong country and achieving national rejuvenation through Chinese modernisation.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 文件提出了系统规划，以在新时代新征程上继续对党实行全面从严治党，为以中国式现代化推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业提供坚强政治保证。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: Days ago, the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China concluded in Beijing. The session reviewed and adopted the Resolution of the Central Committee of the CPC on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance . It sets out systematic plans for continuing to exercise full and rigorous self-governance of the Party on the new journey in the new era, providing a strong political guarantee for advancing the great cause of building a strong country and achieving national rejuvenation through Chinese modernisation. To govern the country well, we must first govern the Party well; only when the Party thrives can the nation prosper. China’s success hinges on the Party, and on exercising full and rigorous Party self-governance. Since the 18th National Congress of the CPC, the Party has advanced full and rigorous self-governance with extraordinary historical courage and strategic resolve. The fight against corruption has achieved an overwhelming victory and been comprehensively consolidated. Practice has fully proven that, as the world’s largest Marxist governing party, the Communist Party of China possesses a powerful capacity to identify problems, correct deviations, and achieve self-purification, self-improvement, self-renewal, and self-enhancement through its own efforts. It has always been the core force leading China’s development and progress and safeguarding the fundamental interests of the people. Self-revolution is not an abstract political concept; it is a realistic driving force that promotes national development and benefits hundreds of millions of people. It is precisely by consistently advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance that the CPC has been able to rally the entire society into a powerful, unified force, translating the efficacy of governance into tangible development results, and writing new chapters in the twin miracles of rapid economic growth and long-term social stability. China has built the world’s largest and most complete industrial system. Its manufacturing value-added has long ranked first globally. It has nurtured a middle-income group of more than 400 million people, historically solved the problem of absolute poverty, and lifted hundreds of millions of rural residents out of poverty. These tangible development achievements are powerful evidence that the Party’s self-revolution empowers national governance and benefits the people. China never exports its development model, attaches no political conditions, and never interferes in the internal affairs of other countries. We always respect every country’s independent choice of a development path suited to its national conditions and are ready to engage in equal exchanges of governance experience with political parties and organisations around the world. China’s development cannot be separated from the world, and the world’s prosperity also needs China. As the world’s second-largest economy, China has the most promising super-large-scale market and has contributed around 30 per cent to global economic growth for many consecutive years, serving as an important multiplier and stabiliser. The series of strategic arrangements made at the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee are not only top-level designs for China’s own long-term development, but also contain development opportunities for the world. A China that persists in self-revolution and continues to develop steadily will keep expanding high-level opening-up and injecting lasting momentum into the stability of global industrial and supply chains and the recovery of the world economy. At present, profound changes unseen in a century are accelerating, and the four deficits in peace, development, security, and governance continue to grow more pronounced. The desire of developing countries to independently explore modernisation paths is becoming ever stronger. Against this backdrop, the CPC’s practice of advancing national governance through self-revolution has drawn wide international attention. This reflects recognition of China’s development path and governance effectiveness, as well as keen interest in the logic of self-revolution in the Party and state governance. China never exports its development model, attaches no political conditions, and never interferes in the internal affairs of other countries. We always respect every country’s independent choice of a development path suited to its national conditions and are ready to engage in equal exchanges of governance experience with political parties and organisations around the world. China continues to put into practice the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative, the Global Civilisation Initiative, and the Global Governance Initiative, working with all parties to explore solutions to global challenges and contributing Chinese wisdom, Chinese solutions, and Chinese strength to building a community with a shared future for mankind. China’s door of opening-up will only open wider. The dividends of China’s development belong not only to the Chinese people but also to the whole world. We warmly look forward to walking hand in hand with friends in Nigeria on the path of equality, mutual learning and mutual benefit, jointly writing a new chapter of solidarity and revitalisation among Global South countries. Africa is a continent full of hope, a key force in the Global South, and an important partner on the path of Chinese modernisation. Within the framework of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation (FOCAC), China has always upheld the principles of sincerity, real results, amity and good faith, as well as the correct approach to justice and interests, and has joined African countries in exploring modernisation. The 2024 FOCAC Beijing Summit was a success, when President Xi Jinping announced the “Ten Partnership Actions” for jointly advancing modernisation, charting a clear blueprint for all-round China-Africa cooperation. Starting from 1 May this year, China has implemented a zero-tariff treatment for all African countries that have diplomatic relations with it, further consolidating its position as Africa’s largest trading partner and helping African countries expand exports and advance industrial transformation. The Communist Party of China is deepening exchanges of experience in Party governance and state administration with political parties across Africa, thereby helping the China-Africa community with a shared future take root and becoming a vivid practice of building a community with a shared future for mankind. Nigeria is Africa’s most populous country and a key engine driving the revitalisation of the African continent. In more than two years as Chinese ambassador to Nigeria, I have deeply felt the strong endogenous demand among all sectors of Nigerian society for good governance, stability and an independently chosen path of modernisation. Nigeria is currently upholding strategic autonomy, pursuing a pragmatic foreign policy, advancing structural reforms, actively attracting foreign investment, expanding international trade, and promoting technological innovation, thereby continuously strengthening the foundations of independent development and demonstrating firm determination to follow a modernisation path suited to its national conditions. Under the strategic guidance of President Xi Jinping and President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, the China-Nigeria comprehensive strategic partnership has entered a new stage of high-quality development. The two sides continue to deepen exchanges of governance experience, closely align their development agendas, and make practical cooperation in various fields more solid, and continuously benefiting the peoples of both countries. Standing at a new historical starting point, China will take the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee as its guide, remain committed to the long-term task of self-revolution, unremittingly advance full and rigorous Party self-governance, firmly follow the path of Chinese modernisation, unswervingly promote high-quality development and expand high-level opening-up, and steadfastly safeguard world peace and promote common development. China’s door of opening-up will only open wider. The dividends of China’s development belong not only to the Chinese people but also to the whole world. We warmly look forward to walking hand in hand with friends in Nigeria on the path of equality, mutual learning and mutual benefit, jointly writing a new chapter of solidarity and revitalisation among Global South countries
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 余敦浩：通过党的自我革命，推动中国式现代化稳步向前
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh: 数日前，中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议在北京闭幕。会议审议并通过了《中共中央关于进一步全面从严治党若干重大问题的决议》，对新时代新征程上继续推进全面从严治党作出系统部署，为推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业提供坚强政治保证。要治国必先治党，党强则国强。中国的成功离不开党，离不开全面从严治党。党的十八大以来，中国共产党以非凡的历史勇气和战略定力推进全面从严治党，反腐败斗争取得决定性胜利并全面巩固。实践充分证明，作为世界上最大的马克思主义执政党，中国共产党具备强大的自我净化、自我完善、自我革新、自我提高能力，始终是引领中国发展进步、维护人民根本利益的核心力量。自我革命不是一个抽象的政治概念，而是推动国家发展、造福亿万人民的现实动力。正是通过持续推进全面从严治党，中国共产党才能把全社会凝聚成强大而团结的力量，把治理效能转化为实实在在的发展成果，在经济快速增长和社会长期稳定两大奇迹中书写新篇章。中国已经建成世界规模最大、体系最完整的工业体系，制造业增加值长期位居全球第一，形成了超过4亿人的中等收入群体，历史性地解决了绝对贫困问题，使数亿农村居民摆脱贫困。这些实实在在的发展成就充分证明，党的自我革命为国家治理赋能、为人民造福。中国从不输出发展模式，不附加政治条件，不干涉他国内政，始终尊重各国自主选择符合自身国情的发展道路，并愿同世界各国政党、组织平等交流治理经验。中国的发展离不开世界，世界繁荣也需要中国。作为世界第二大经济体，中国拥有前景最可期的超大规模市场，多年来对全球经济增长贡献率保持在30%左右，是重要的增长放大器和稳定器。中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议作出的一系列战略部署，不仅是中国自身长期发展的顶层设计，也为世界带来发展机遇。一个坚持自我革命、持续稳步发展的中国，将不断扩大高水平开放，为全球产业链供应链稳定和世界经济复苏注入持久动力。当前，百年未有之大变局加速演进，和平、发展、安全、治理四大赤字日益突出。发展中国家自主探索现代化道路的愿望日益强烈。在此背景下，中国共产党以自我革命推进国家治理的实践受到广泛关注，这既反映国际社会对中国发展道路和治理成效的认可，也体现各方对党和国家治理中自我革命逻辑的浓厚兴趣。中国从不输出发展模式，不附加政治条件，不干涉他国内政，始终尊重各国自主选择符合自身国情的发展道路，并愿同世界各国政党、组织平等交流治理经验。中国持续落实全球发展倡议、全球安全倡议、全球文明倡议和全球治理倡议，同各方一道探索应对全球挑战的解决方案，为构建人类命运共同体贡献中国智慧、中国方案、中国力量。中国的开放大门只会越开越大。中国发展的红利不仅属于中国人民，也属于全世界。我们热切期待同尼日利亚朋友们携手并进，走平等互学、互利共赢之路，共同书写全球南方国家团结振兴的新篇章。非洲是一个充满希望的大陆，是全球南方的重要力量，也是中国现代化道路上的重要伙伴。在中非合作论坛框架内，中国始终坚持真实亲诚、合作共赢精神，坚持正确义利观，同非洲国家一道探索现代化道路。2024年中非合作论坛北京峰会取得成功，习近平主席宣布“中非十大伙伴行动”，为中非全面合作绘就清晰蓝图。自今年5月1日起，中国对同其建交的非洲国家全部实施零关税待遇，进一步巩固中国作为非洲最大贸易伙伴的地位，助力非洲国家扩大出口、推进产业转型。中国共产党正深化同非洲各政党在党的建设和国家治理方面的经验交流，助力中非命运共同体 rooted 落地，成为构建人类命运共同体的生动实践。尼日利亚是非洲人口最多的国家，也是推动非洲大陆振兴的重要引擎。担任中国驻尼日利亚大使两年多来，我深切感受到尼日利亚社会各阶层对良好治理、稳定环境和自主选择现代化道路的强大内生需求。尼日利亚目前坚持战略自主奉行务实外交政策，推进结构改革，积极吸引外资，扩大国际贸易，推动科技创新，不断夯实独立发展基础，展现出坚定走符合本国国情现代化道路的决心。在习近平主席和博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统的战略指导下，中尼全面战略伙伴关系进入高质量发展新阶段。双方继续深化治理经验交流，紧密对接发展议程，推动各领域务实合作更加扎实，不断造福两国人民。站在新的历史起点上，中国将以中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议精神为指引，坚持自我革命这一长期任务，不断推进全面从严治党，坚定走中国式现代化道路，坚定不移推动高质量发展、扩大高水平开放，坚定维护世界和平、促进共同发展。中国的开放大门只会越开越大。中国发展的红利不仅属于中国人民，也属于全世界。我们热切期待同尼日利亚朋友们携手并进，走平等互学、互利共赢之路，共同书写全球南方国家团结振兴的新篇章

Unlock these with Subscription India has secured preliminary investment commitments worth $400 billion across the renewable energy sector, including green hydrogen, energy storage and transmission, among others, Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi said on Wednesday. Speaking to reporters on the sidelines of the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo, Mr. Joshi said the commitments were made during a CEO roundtable involving global investors and fund managers. “The fund managers have taken all the details and have given a commitment of $400 billion,” he said, adding that the figures were preliminary and the final details were being worked out. The minister said overseas investors had expressed confidence in India’s investment climate. “I also met the Canadian Investment Fund – they are one of the biggest funds. They also said this (India) was the safest place for investment,” he said. Separately, the government will consult industry stakeholders over the next 10-15 days before deciding whether to extend the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) framework, Mr. Joshi said. The framework, which mandates the use of domestically approved solar module manufacturers for specified projects, was last extended in July until December 31 for solar PV cells. He said India’s solar cell manufacturing capacity currently stood at 41 GW, while manufacturers had committed to adding another 70 GW by the end of the year. Acknowledging divergent views within the industry on extending the ALMM framework, he said the government would hear both sides before taking a decision. “Some people want it to be extended, some people do not want it. We will listen to them, talk to both and we are not in a hurry to take a decision on that, [and] in another 10-15 days we will discuss with both the stakeholder associations,” he said. 乔希先生在 Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 期间对记者表示，这些投资承诺是在一次有全球投资者和基金经理参加的首席执行官圆桌会议上作出的。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Some expect Trump to press ahead, but Seoul could be sidelined even if talks resume The Democrats’ victory in both the House and Senate in Tuesday's (local time) U.S. midterm elections has made a summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un even less likely, analysts said Wednesday, though others argued that Trump’s tendency to shrug off political pressure means he may keep pursuing a meeting regardless.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 有人预计特朗普会继续推进，但即使谈判恢复，首尔也可能被排除在外。分析人士周三表示，民主党在当地时间周二举行的美国中期选举中同时赢得众议院和参议院，使得美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩举行峰会的可能性进一步降低。不过，也有人认为，特朗普无视政治压力的倾向意味着他无论如何都会继续寻求会面。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Some expect Trump to press ahead, but Seoul could be sidelined even if talks resume The Democrats’ victory in both the House and Senate in Tuesday's (local time) U.S. midterm elections has made a summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un even less likely, analysts said Wednesday, though others argued that Trump’s tendency to shrug off political pressure means he may keep pursuing a meeting regardless. A Trump-Kim meeting had been floated as a possible diplomatic surprise around the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, scheduled for Nov. 18 and 19 in Shenzhen, China. The two leaders met three times during Trump’s first term from 2017 to 2021, but a fourth meeting was already in doubt before the elections, given Kim’s lukewarm response to renewed U.S. outreach. Some analysts said the prospect has also lost some of its appeal as a headline-grabbing event, with attention shifting to a possible U.S.-China-Russia summit in Shenzhen. “I think a Democratic victory would put serious brakes on both Trump’s efforts to meet Kim and the South Korean government’s outreach to North Korea,” Ahn said. “Even if they meet for the sake of the event, there would be limits on what could follow,” Shin said. “Would Kim want to meet a weakened Trump?” Shin noted the prospect of a U.S.-China-Russia summit in Shenzhen could matter more than the midterm result. If Trump had a chance to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, he said, the U.S. president “would have less reason to pursue a separate encounter with the North Korean leader.” Others argued that closer congressional scrutiny of his administration and fewer allies on Capitol Hill could lead Trump to spend more time on foreign policy and step up his outreach to Kim and Xi. Andrew Yeo, a professor of politics at the Catholic University of America, said Democratic efforts to scale back Trump’s war in the Middle East could draw attention away from North Korea. But he said the decision to meet would still rest with the two leaders. “If Kim Jong-un states that he’s prepared to meet Trump, Trump will make that meeting happen,” Yeo said. Fred Fleitz, a former chief of staff of the U.S. National Security Council and vice chair of the America First Policy Institute, said Democratic criticism of a Trump-Kim meeting could intensify, but he expected Trump to disregard it. “I think Trump’s going to do what he wants to do,” Fleitz said. Sean King, a senior vice president at Park Strategies, said pressure at home could make Trump more inclined to pursue personal diplomacy. “Facing congressional investigations, and with fewer friends on Capitol Hill, President Trump is now sure to spend more time on foreign policy,” King said. “I suspect he’ll sadly go out of his way, even more than he already has, to court and placate the likes of Kim Jong-un and Xi Jinping.” The election results come as President Lee Jae Myung has urged Trump to serve as a “peacemaker” on the Korean Peninsula while offering himself as a “pacemaker," hoping U.S. outreach can create an opening for inter-Korean dialogue. Ahn said Seoul could “find itself sidelined” even if the summit goes ahead, with Washington seeking to retain control of its dealings with Pyongyang. “We should be very careful about assuming that better relations between the U.S. and North Korea will improve our own relations with the North,” he said. Shin said the U.S. midterm elections would have little immediate effect on Lee’s outreach because Pyongyang was already unwilling to engage with Seoul
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 分析师称，民主党在美国中期选举中大获全胜，使特朗普与金正恩峰会的前景更加黯淡
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
有人预计特朗普会继续推进，但即使谈判恢复，首尔也可能被边缘化。分析人士周三表示，民主党在周二（当地时间）举行的美国中期选举中同时赢得众议院和参议院，这使美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩举行峰会的可能性进一步降低。不过，也有人认为，特朗普无视政治压力的倾向意味着他可能无论如何都会继续寻求会面。

此前曾有人提出，特朗普与金正恩可能会在定于11月18日至19日于中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会期间实现一次出人意料的外交会晤。特朗普在2017年至2021年第一任期内曾与金正恩会面3次，但在此次选举之前，第四次会面就已存在疑问，因为金正恩对恢复美国方面的接触反应冷淡。

一些分析人士称，随着焦点转向可能在美国、中国和俄罗斯于深圳举行的峰会，特朗普与金正恩会面作为吸引头条事件的吸引力也有所下降。“我认为，民主党的胜利会严重阻碍特朗普试图与金正恩会面的努力，也会严重阻碍韩国政府与朝鲜接触的尝试。”安说。“即使双方为了活动本身而会面，后续能取得什么成果也会受到限制。”申说。“金正恩会想见一个处于弱势的特朗普吗？”

申指出，在深圳举行美国、中国和俄罗斯峰会的可能性，可能比中期选举结果更重要。他说，如果特朗普有机会会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，那么这位美国总统“就更没有理由单独与朝鲜领导人会面”。

另一些人认为，国会对其政府的更密切审查以及其在国会山盟友减少，可能促使特朗普投入更多时间处理外交政策，并加强对金正恩和习近平的接触。美国天主教大学政治学教授安德鲁·约奥说，民主党为缩减特朗普在中东战争上的投入而作出的努力，可能会使人们的注意力从朝鲜问题上移开。但他说，是否会面的决定仍将由两位领导人作出。“如果金正恩表示他准备与特朗普会面，特朗普就会让这次会面成为现实。”约奥说。

美国国家安全委员会前幕僚长、美国优先政策研究所副主席弗雷德·弗莱茨说，民主党对特朗普与金正恩会面的批评可能会加剧，但他预计特朗普会不予理会。“我认为特朗普会做他想做的事。”弗莱茨说。

Park Strategies高级副总裁肖恩·金说，国内压力可能使特朗普更倾向于推行个人外交。“面对国会调查，而且在国会山的朋友更少，特朗普总统现在肯定会投入更多时间处理外交政策。”金说。“我担心，他会刻意迎合和安抚金正恩、习近平之类的人物，而且这种倾向甚至会比现在更强。”

选举结果公布之际，李在明总统已敦促特朗普在朝鲜半岛问题上充当“调停者”，同时自我定位为“协调者”，希望美国方面的接触能为朝韩对话创造契机。安说，即使峰会如期举行，首尔也可能“发现自己被边缘化”，因为华盛顿寻求继续掌控与平壤的交涉。“我们在假定美朝关系改善会带动我们与朝鲜的关系改善时，必须非常谨慎。”他说。

申说，美国中期选举对李的接触政策不会产生太大即时影响，因为平壤已经不愿与首尔展开接触

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Democratic control of US Congress raises prospect of weaker dollar, experts say The Korean won is expected to strengthen against the U.S. dollar after Democrats swept both chambers of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, as political tensions in Washington and a potential sell-off in U.S. equities could weigh on the dollar, experts said Wednesday. Democratic control of Congress is expected to complicate U.S. President Donald Trump's efforts to advance his economic agenda, including tax cuts and expanded government spending, while giving lawmakers greater power to scrutinize his administration's policies. The prospect of a prolonged standoff between the White House and Congress could unsettle investors and undermine confidence in U.S. financial markets, said Shin Se-don, an economics professor at Sookmyung Women's University. "A fierce confrontation between Congress and the Trump administration will be inevitable. Trump's economic policy initiatives could face setbacks as Democrats step up opposition to the administration's policies, potentially slowing growth across the broader U.S. economy," Shin said. The political fallout could spill over into financial markets, particularly U.S. technology stocks tied to artificial intelligence (AI) and digital infrastructure. Shin said concerns over excessive investment in AI had already put technology stocks under pressure, and that political turmoil could further weigh on the broader U.S. stock market. "Market correction would make U.S. financial assets less attractive to investors. A slowdown in investment could weaken the dollar and give the Korean won room to further appreciate," the professor said. Shin also noted that the won-dollar exchange rate could be influenced more heavily by domestic factors, including Korea's current account balance and exporters' dollar selling. The won has strengthened in recent months, with the won-dollar exchange rate falling from the 1,500 won range in June to the 1,300 won range in October. The monthly average rate declined from 1,527.95 won per dollar in June to 1,488.92 won in July, 1,404.35 won in August, 1,358.75 won in September and 1,335.70 won in October, according to the Bank of Korea. Kim Dae-jong, a professor of business administration at Sejong University, also expects the won to strengthen further in the near term following the U.S. midterm results, citing constraints on the Trump administration's economic policies. "With Democrats controlling Congress, it will be harder for the Trump administration to borrow heavily to finance government spending or push through further tax cuts," Kim said. "That could ease pressure on U.S. Treasury yields and the won-dollar exchange rate." A weaker dollar would lower Korea's import costs for crude oil and raw materials, helping ease inflationary pressure on energy and food prices, he said. But the stronger won could hurt Korean exporters by reducing the value of their dollar-denominated earnings when converted into won. Kim, however, warned that the won could reverse course and weaken over the longer term if the momentum in the semiconductor export boom fades. In recent months, strong chip exports, particularly memory semiconductors used in AI infrastructure, have been a major source of dollar inflows and helped support the won. "In the longer term, a potential loss of momentum in the Trump administration's AI support policies under a Democratic-controlled Congress could dampen global investment sentiment toward AI and semiconductor markets, ultimately weighing on Korea's chip exports," Kim said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 民主党横扫中期选举后，韩元兑美元料走强
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 专家称，民主党掌控美国国会为美元走弱带来可能前景。专家周三表示，在美国中期选举中民主党横扫国会两院后，韩元预计将兑美元走强，因为华盛顿的政治紧张局势以及美国股市可能出现的抛售都会令美元承压。民主党掌控国会，预计将使美国总统唐纳德·特朗普更难推进其经济议程，包括减税和扩大政府支出，同时也赋予议员更大的权力审查其政府的政策。梨花女子大学经济学教授申世敦说，白宫与国会长期僵持的前景可能令投资者不安，并削弱对美国金融市场的信心。申说：“国会与特朗普政府之间的激烈对抗不可避免。随着民主党加强对政府政策的反对，特朗普的经济政策举措可能遭遇挫折，从而可能拖慢美国整体经济的增长。”政治局势的冲击可能外溢至金融市场，尤其是与人工智能和数字基础设施相关的美国科技股。申说，对人工智能过度投资的担忧已经令科技股承压，而政治动荡可能进一步拖累美国整体股市。这位教授说：“市场调整会降低美国金融资产对投资者的吸引力。投资放缓可能削弱美元，并为韩元进一步升值创造空间。”申还指出，韩元兑美元汇率可能更多受到国内因素影响，包括韩国经常账户余额以及出口商抛售美元的行为。韩国央行数据显示，韩元近几个月持续升值，兑美元汇率从6月的1,500韩元区间降至10月的1,300韩元区间。月均汇率从6月的每美元1,527.95韩元降至7月的1,488.92韩元、8月的1,404.35韩元、9月的1,358.75韩元和10月的1,335.70韩元。世宗大学工商管理学教授金大中预计，美国中期选举结果公布后，韩元近期也将进一步走强，原因是特朗普政府的经济政策受到制约。金说：“民主党掌控国会后，特朗普政府将更难大举借债为政府支出融资，也更难推动进一步减税。这可能缓解美国国债收益率和韩元兑美元汇率承受的压力。”他说，美元走弱会降低韩国进口原油和原材料的成本，有助于缓解能源和食品价格的通胀压力。不过，韩元走强也可能损害韩国出口商，因为其以美元计价的收益折算成韩元后价值会下降。然而，金警告称，如果半导体出口热潮的势头消退，韩元可能逆转走势并在更长期内走弱。近几个月来，强劲的芯片出口，特别是用于人工智能基础设施的存储半导体，是美元流入的重要来源，并帮助支撑韩元。金说：“从长期来看，在民主党掌控国会的情况下，特朗普政府的人工智能支持政策可能失去动力，进而削弱全球投资者对人工智能和半导体市场的信心，最终拖累韩国的芯片出口……”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.title: Tinubu Slashes External Borrowing Request to $7.7bn, Seeks Senate Approval
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary: The Senate President, Godswill Akpabio, disclosed this Wednesday while reading a fresh letter from Tinubu during plenary, explaining that the new request effectively superseded the previous borrowing proposal submitted to the National Assembly. Explaining the significance of the revised communication, Akpabio said the fresh request effectively cancelled the earlier proposal read by him from Tinubu on October 27, seeking approval for $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion in external borrowing.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary_zh: 参议院议长戈德斯维尔·阿克帕比奥星期三在全会上宣读蒂努布最新信函时透露，这项新请求实际上取代了此前提交国民议会的借款方案。阿克帕比奥在解释这封修订函的重要性时说，这项新请求实际上取消了他于10月27日代表蒂努布宣读的早期方案；该方案寻求批准 205.2 亿美元和 10.45 亿欧元的外部借款。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body: New proposal replaces earlier $20.52bn and €1.045bn borrowing plan, says Akpabio Funds to finance 2026 budget deficit, support reserves, stabilise naira President Bola Tinubu has revised the Federal Government’s external borrowing plan for 2026, seeking Senate approval for a fresh $7.707 billion (N10.79 trillion) loan to finance part of the budget deficit, replacing an earlier request for $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion. The Senate President, Godswill Akpabio, disclosed this Wednesday while reading a fresh letter from Tinubu during plenary, explaining that the new request effectively superseded the previous borrowing proposal submitted to the National Assembly. The revised request, dated October 26, 2026, seeks legislative authorisation for the Federal Government to raise the equivalent of N10.79 trillion in external financing as part of the funding arrangements for the 2026 Appropriation Act. The president explained that the proposed external borrowing formed part of the N29.2 trillion new borrowing provision in the 2026 budget, designed to finance the country’s estimated N31.4 trillion budget deficit. Under the revised financing arrangement, the Federal Government plans to raise N10.79 trillion externally, while N18.4 trillion would be sourced from the domestic debt market. Tinubu said the external financing would be mobilised through several channels, including Eurobond issuance, concessional and commercial loans from multilateral and bilateral institutions, International Monetary Fund (IMF) facilities and bridge financing arrangements. However, he indicated that the government would place greater emphasis on Eurobond issuance because of its relatively faster processing time and capacity to generate substantial funds at comparatively lower costs. The president said: “All the options will be pursued simultaneously, considering the costs and related benefits to the country and the time required to access the funds. “In view of this, emphasis will be on the issuance of Eurobonds, which is typically faster to conclude. Additionally, a large amount can be raised through Eurobonds at a relatively lower cost.” He explained that the final terms and conditions of the proposed facilities would be determined by prevailing market conditions when the loans were being priced. According to him, the Federal Ministry of Finance and the Debt Management Office (DMO) would work together to ensure that the country secured the most favourable borrowing terms. Tinubu said the proposed funds would finance projects and programmes captured in the 2026 Appropriation Act, particularly in critical sectors considered essential to economic growth and national development. He identified defence and security, transportation, agriculture, power, education and healthcare as priority areas expected to benefit from the proposed external financing. The president explained that the borrowing was necessary to sustain the implementation of the administration’s economic reform agenda and consolidate the gains recorded over the past few years. “The new external borrowings are required to implement the items, programmes and projects in the 2026 Appropriation Act, which are designed to consolidate and strengthen the macroeconomic reforms and gains recorded by this administration in the past few years,” he said. Beyond financing budgetary obligations, Tinubu said the proposed borrowing would also strengthen Nigeria’s external reserves and provide additional support for exchange-rate stability. He explained that the foreign currency proceeds would be received by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) on behalf of the Federal Government, thereby increasing the country’s foreign reserves. “It is also important to add that the process will increase the accretion to the external reserves, since the funds will be received by the Central Bank of Nigeria on behalf of the Federal Government, thereby supporting the naira exchange rate,” he stated. The president anchored his request on Sections 21(1) and 27(1) of the Debt Management Office (Establishment, etc.) Act, 2003, which provide for legislative approval of external borrowing and empower the National Assembly to approve the terms and conditions of such facilities. He specifically asked the Senate to approve the proposed N10.79 trillion borrowing, equivalent to $7.707 billion, based on the 2026 budget exchange rate of N1,400 to the dollar. Tinubu also sought the Senate’s authorisation for the Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economy, in collaboration with the DMO, to take the necessary steps to implement the borrowing arrangement. Explaining the significance of the revised communication, Akpabio said the fresh request effectively cancelled the earlier proposal read by him from Tinubu on October 27, seeking approval for $20.52 billion and €1.045 billion in external borrowing. He said the latest letter was more explicit about the government’s financing requirements and provided greater flexibility in sourcing funds from different international markets and institutions. Akpabio said: “I believe this letter effectively cancels the earlier request that was sent for $20-something billion. But this is much more explicit.” The Senate President explained that the revised arrangement recognised that the Federal Government would not necessarily obtain all the required funds from a single source, but would explore different financing opportunities to secure competitive terms. According to him, “This also takes cognisance of the fact that the borrowing is not going to take effect from only one location. So we have to go out there and search for the best terms, what we may call a willing-seller, willing-buyer approach.” Following the presentation of the presidential communication, Akpabio referred the request to the Senate Committee on Local and Foreign Debts for further legislative scrutiny. He asked the committee to examine the proposed borrowing arrangements and report back to the Senate for consideration, “as soon as practicable”. The revised borrowing request comes amid continuing concerns over Nigeria’s rising public debt obligations, the growing cost of debt servicing and the government’s dependence on borrowing to finance budgetary commitments. With the 2026 budget providing for substantial new borrowing, the Senate’s consideration of Tinubu’s request is expected to focus not only on the proposed financing arrangements but also on the country’s capacity to manage additional external debt and ensure that borrowed funds are deployed for the purposes stated by the government. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.title_zh: 蒂努布将外部借款申请削减至77亿美元，并寻求参议院批准
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body_zh: 阿克帕比奥称，新方案取代此前205.2亿美元和10.45亿欧元的借款计划，将为2026年预算赤字融资、补充储备并稳定奈拉。总统博拉·蒂努布已修订联邦政府2026年对外借款计划，正寻求参议院批准一笔新的77.07亿美元（10.79万亿奈拉）贷款，用于填补部分预算赤字，取代此前提出的205.2亿美元和10.45亿欧元贷款申请。参议院议长戈斯威尔·阿克帕比奥本周三在全会上宣读蒂努布的一封新信时披露了此事，并解释说，新的申请实际上取代了此前提交国民议会的借款方案。修订后的申请日期为2026年10月26日，请求立法机构授权联邦政府筹集相当于10.79万亿奈拉的对外融资，作为2026年拨款法案资金安排的一部分。总统表示，拟议的对外借款是2026年预算中292万亿奈拉新增借款额度的一部分，旨在填补该国预计高达31.4万亿奈拉的预算赤字。根据修订后的融资安排，联邦政府计划从外部筹集10.79万亿奈拉，其余18.4万亿奈拉则从国内债务市场筹集。蒂努布表示，对外融资将通过多个渠道筹措，包括发行欧洲债券、从多边及双边机构获取优惠贷款和商业贷款、国际货币基金组织（IMF）融资工具以及过桥融资安排。不过，他指出，政府将更加重视发行欧洲债券，因为其处理周期相对较短，且能够以相对较低的成本筹集大量资金。总统说：“我们将同时考虑所有方案，综合考量相关成本及其对国家的好处，以及取得资金所需的时间。鉴于这些因素，我们将重点发行欧洲债券，因为通常完成得更快。此外，通过欧洲债券可以以相对较低的成本筹集巨额资金。”他解释说，拟议融资工具的最终条款和条件将在贷款定价时根据当时的市场状况确定。据他介绍，联邦财政部和债务管理办公室（DMO）将协同合作，确保国家获得最优厚的借款条件。蒂努布表示，拟议资金将用于实施2026年拨款法案所列的项目和计划，尤其是对经济增长和国家发展至关重要的一些关键领域。他列举的优先受益领域包括国防与安全、交通、农业、电力、教育和医疗。总统解释说，借款对于持续推进政府经济改革议程以及巩固过去几年取得的成果至关重要。他说：“新的对外借款对于落实2026年拨款法案中的事项、计划和项目至关重要，这些事项、计划和项目旨在巩固和加强本届政府过去几年实现的宏观经济改革与成果。”蒂努布表示，除履行预算义务外，拟议借款还将增强尼日利亚的外汇储备，并为汇率稳定提供额外支持。他解释说，外币所得将由尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）代表联邦政府接收，从而增加国家外汇储备。他说：“此外还必须强调，这一过程将增加外汇储备，因为资金将由尼日利亚中央银行代表联邦政府接收，从而为奈拉汇率提供支撑。”总统以《2003年债务管理办公室（设立等）法》第21(1)条和第27(1)条为申请依据。这些条款规定，对外借款须经立法机构批准，并授权国民议会批准此类融资工具的条款和条件。他特别请求参议院批准拟议的10.79万亿奈拉借款，按2026年预算中1奈拉兑1美元的汇率计算，相当于77.07亿美元。蒂努布还请求参议院授权财政部长兼经济协调部长与DMO协作，采取必要措施落实借款安排。阿克帕比奥在解释修订后函件的重要性时表示，新的申请实际上取消了他于10月27日代蒂努布宣读的此前方案；该方案请求批准205.2亿美元和10.45亿欧元的对外借款。他说，最新函件更明确地说明了政府的融资需求，也为从不同国际市场和机构筹集资金提供了更大灵活性。阿克帕比奥说：“我认为，这封函件实际上取消了此前提交的200多亿美元申请。但这封函件明确得多。”参议院议长解释说，修订后的安排确认联邦政府未必会从单一来源取得全部所需资金，而是将寻求不同的融资机会，以获得有竞争力的条件。据他介绍，“这也考虑到借款不会只从一个地方取得。因此，我们必须走出去寻找最佳条件，也就是我们所谓的卖方愿意、买方也愿意的方式。”在介绍总统函件后，阿克帕比奥将申请交由参议院地方债务和对外债务委员会进一步审议。他要求该委员会审查拟议借款安排，并“尽快”向参议院提交报告供其审议。修订后的借款申请出台之际，尼日利亚公共债务负担不断上升、偿债成本持续增加，政府依赖借款履行预算承诺所引发的担忧仍在持续。由于2026年预算安排了规模庞大的新增借款，参议院审议蒂努布申请时，预计不仅会关注拟议融资安排，也会关注国家管理新增对外债务的能力，以及确保借入资金按照政府所述用途部署。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY https://leadership.ng/how-democrats-seiz.body: Obviously dazed by the results, Trump took it in good faith and told media outlets he would accept the election results and was prepared to work with Democrats. From Texas comes shocking results where James Talarico roundly defeated Republican Ken Paxton, becoming the state’s first Democratic senator-elect in 38 years. In South Carolina where the Democrats have not won a Senate Seat in this century, the party made history as Annie Andrews defeated Republican Senator Darline Graham another shocking results. Democrats also won in Ohio, a state Trump won three times but this time Democrat Sherrod Brown won. In Kansas, where Democrats last won election in 1932, Democrat Adam Hamilton routed Republican incumbent Roger Marshall. Trump and his party perhaps suffered the biggest setback as with Latino voters massively voted against them. In previous election years, Republicans had counted on that major group of swing voters for wins from California to Florida. However, Texas, where 4 in 10 people are Latino, Democrats flipped both the governor and Senate seats, as earlier predicted. In southeast Florida, dominated by Latinos, Democrat Pia Dandiya emerged victorious. President Trump enjoyed massive Latino voters on his way to victory in 2024, when he won nearly half the Hispanic vote, up from roughly one-third in 2020. But two years later many have abandoned Trump and the reason is predicated on economic anger that has driven Republican support down. Democrats Gina Hinojosa, who will become the first Latina governor of Texas, and Xavier Becerra, who will be California’s first elected Latino governor, demonstrated the importance of the Hispanic electorate. Analysts believe that the massive victories recorded by Democrats was instigated by a large turnout of party faithful and independent voters who broke their way in both swing states and Republican strongholds. Democrats also gambled by fielding a candidate in every race irrespective of how less popular they might be. The votes probably reflect the reality many Americans have faced in recent times. The mood was that of anger and frustration against the Trump administration especially about high prices and the agenda of Trump that is leading the country to a direction most Americans are not comfortable with. President Trump returned to power in 2024 after routing the Republican candidate Kamala Harris. His victory was hinged on a promise to address soaring inflation. However, his catalogue of errors especially his high and probably ill-advised imposition of high tariffs on foreign goods reportedly made life more difficult for Americans. The President worsened the situation when he told Americans to absorb the higher costs, and this instantly made his popularity plummets. Records showed that nearly two-thirds of voters in the exit polls hold the President culpable for high prices, while three-quarters said they were either angry or dissatisfied with the direction of the country. According to analysis by Tim Reid and Trevor Hunnicutt the poor results wasn’t just a bad night for Republicans; it was a bad night for Trump personally. He suffered a series of defeats as several candidates he had elevated over the objections of local Republicans struggled in races the party expected to win. “Trump’s handpicked Senate candidates in South Carolina and North Carolina, Graham and Michael Whatley, lost their races, while Paxton in Texas was soundly beaten. Trump’s choices put Republicans on the defensive in states where they had been favored to win. “The losses are likely to revive questions about Trump’s political instincts, particularly his tendency to prioritize personal loyalty over candidates with broader electoral appeal. The exit polls showed that the coalition of voters that powered his 2024 victory is badly fractured. Republicans recorded sharp declines in support among Black men, Latinos and young voters,” they stated. There is also the vexed issue of the unending war in Iran, which has gulped large amount of resources and helping to drive the prices of oil causing more global crisis. Trump’s campaign of calumny, which painted Democrats as “dangerous radicals and communists who would destroy the country if elected,” failed to resonate with the people as they were more concerned about high prices of groceries and gas and wanted to hear more from Trump about how he would lower costs. Voters wanted a more persuasive approach from Trump, whom they have trusted with power, but they were disappointed and this has reflected in the outcome of the election. In the final analysis the Democrats might be riding on the crest of a wave at the moment with this massive victories, however, this might present difficult challenges as voters will likely look to up to them to address their economic concerns and not just oppose Trump. They will have the leverage of majority but might be limited in what legislation they can pass as the president retains veto power. The coming days will present the shape of things to come. https://leadership.ng/how-democrats-seiz.title_zh: 民主党人如何掌控美国参议院，以及这对特朗普和共和党人的重大影响
https://leadership.ng/how-democrats-seiz.body_zh: 显然，这次选举结果令特朗普头晕目眩，但他善意接受了结果，并告诉媒体，他愿意接受选举结果，也准备与民主党人合作。得克萨斯州传出令人震惊的结果，詹姆斯·塔拉里科全面击败共和党人肯·帕克斯顿，成为该州38年来首位当选的民主党联邦参议员。在本世纪民主党人从未赢得联邦参议院席位的南卡罗来纳州，该党也创造了历史：安妮·安德鲁斯击败共和党联邦参议员达琳·格雷厄姆，又一项令人震惊的结果。民主党人还在俄亥俄州获胜；特朗普曾三次赢得该州，但这次民主党人谢罗德·布朗获胜。在民主党人上一次赢得选举是在1932年的堪萨斯州，民主党人亚当·汉密尔顿 rout 现任共和党人罗杰·马歇尔。特朗普及其政党或许遭受了最严重的挫折，因为拉丁裔选民大规模投票反对他们。在以往选举年份，共和党人依靠这一庞大的摇摆选民群体，从加利福尼亚州到佛罗里达州都借助他们取得胜利。然而，如先前所预测，在每10人中有4人是拉丁裔的得克萨斯州，民主党人翻转了州长和联邦参议院两个席位。在拉丁裔占主导地位的佛罗里达州东南部，民主党人皮娅·丹迪亚获胜。2024年特朗普前往拉丁裔选民中赢得几乎一半的西语裔选票，较2020年约三分之一有所上升，从而在通往胜利的途中赢得大量拉丁裔选民支持。但两年后，许多人已经抛弃特朗普，原因在于经济方面的愤怒情绪压低了对共和党的支持。即将成为得克萨斯州首位拉丁裔州长的民主党人吉娜·希诺霍萨，以及将成为加利福尼亚州首位经选举产生的拉丁裔州长的泽维尔·贝塞拉，凸显了西语裔选民群体的重要作用。分析人士认为，民主党人取得的大胜，是因为大量党内忠诚选民和独立选民 turnout，他们在摇摆州和共和党据点都支持民主党。与此同时，民主党人还在每一项竞选中都推出候选人，尽管这些候选人的知名度可能较低，实际上是在孤注一掷。这些选票或许反映了近年来许多美国人所面对的现实。人们的情绪是愤怒和沮丧，尤其针对特朗普政府的高物价，以及特朗普的议程正把国家带向多数美国人并不认同的方向。2024年，特朗普在 rout 共和党候选人卡玛拉·哈里斯后重返权力中心。他的胜利关键在于承诺应对飙升的通货膨胀。然而，他一系列失误，尤其是大幅且可能未经深思熟虑地对外国商品征收高关税，据称让美国人的生活更加艰难。当总统告诉美国人自行承担更高的成本时，局势进一步恶化，他的支持率也随即暴跌。记录显示，出口民调中近三分之二的选民认为总统应为高物价负责，四分之三的受访者表示，他们对国家的发展方向感到愤怒或不满。Tim Reid和Trevor Hunnicutt的分析称，糟糕的成绩对共和党而言不只是糟糕的一夜，对特朗普个人而言也是糟糕的一夜。他遭遇了一连串失败，因为几名他不顾当地共和党人反对而力捧的候选人，在该党原本预计会获胜的竞选中举步维艰。“特朗普亲自挑选的南卡罗来纳州和北卡罗来纳州联邦参议员候选人格雷厄姆和迈克尔·沃特利败选，而得克萨斯州的帕克斯顿也遭到彻底击败。特朗普的选择使共和党人在原本有望获胜的州份陷入防守。“他们表示，“这些失败很可能重新引发人们对特朗普政治直觉的质疑，尤其是他往往优先考虑个人忠诚，而非拥有更广泛选举吸引力的候选人。出口民调显示，助他在2024年获胜的选民联盟已经严重分裂。共和党在黑人男性、拉丁裔和年轻选民中的支持率大幅下降。”此外，伊朗无休止的战争也是一个棘手问题，这场战争消耗了大量资源，并助推油价上涨，引发更多全球危机。特朗普的抹黑campaign把民主党人描绘成“危险的激进分子和共产主义者，称他们若当选就会摧毁国家”，但这种说法未能引起民众共鸣，因为民众更关心食品杂货和汽油的高价，并希望听到特朗普更多关于如何降低成本的说明。选民希望特朗普采取更有说服力的做法；他们曾把权力托付给他，却感到失望，而这一点反映在选举结果中。归根结底，凭借这次大胜，民主党人目前或许正乘势而上，但这也可能带来艰难挑战，因为选民很可能会期待他们解决经济问题，而不只是反对特朗普。他们将拥有多数席位带来的优势，但由于总统保留否决权，能够通过的立法可能有限。接下来的日子将预示未来的走向。我们掌握着优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角，直接送达您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS 的 WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候最新消息 →

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary: The Senate has received a request from President Bola Tinubu seeking approval for N10.79 trillion external borrowing equivalent to approximately 7.7 billion US dollars to finance part of the 2026 budget deficit. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that Tinubu’s request was contained in a letter seeking the National Assembly for the implementation of external borrowings approved in the 2026 Appropriation Act.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.summary_zh: 尼日利亚参议院收到总统博拉·蒂努布提出的请求，寻求批准107.9万亿奈拉外债，相当于约77亿美元，用于填补2026年预算赤字的一部分。尼日利亚通讯社（NAN）报道，蒂努布在信函中请求国民议会落实《2026年拨款法》批准的对外借款。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body: The Senate has received a request from President Bola Tinubu seeking approval for N10.79 trillion external borrowing equivalent to approximately 7.7 billion US dollars to finance part of the 2026 budget deficit. The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reports that Tinubu’s request was contained in a letter seeking the National Assembly for the implementation of external borrowings approved in the 2026 Appropriation Act. Reading the letter during plenary, Senate President Godswill Akpabio said the request was made pursuant to Sections 21(1) and 27(1) of the Debt Management Office Establishment Act, 2003. In the letter, Tinubu recalled that the 2026 Appropriation Act provided for N29.2 trillion in new borrowings to finance a budget deficit of about N31.4 trillion. He explained that the borrowing comprised N18.4 trillion domestic borrowing and N10.79 trillion external borrowing, with the latter forming the subject of the request. According to the letter, the federal government plans to raise approximately 7.7 billion dollars through one or a combination of available funding sources. He said the proposed sources included concessional and commercial loans from multilateral and bilateral institutions, the International Monetary Fund, bridge financing facilities, direct borrowing from international financial institutions and Eurobond issuance. The president said the options would be pursued simultaneously, considering their respective costs, benefits and the time required to access the funds. Tinubu, however, he said greater emphasis would be placed on Eurobond issuance because it was generally faster to conclude and could raise larger amounts at relatively competitive costs. Tinubu explained that the final borrowing terms, including interest rates and tenures, would depend on prevailing market conditions at the time of pricing. He assured that the Federal Ministry of Finance and the Debt Management Office would work to secure the best possible terms for the country. The president said the proposed borrowing would finance priority projects in defence and security, transportation, agriculture, power, education and health. He noted that the funds would be received by the Central Bank of Nigeria on behalf of the federal government and would also support external reserves. The president consequently requested the National Assembly to authorise the federal government to implement the N10.79 trillion external borrowing, equivalent to approximately 7.7 billion dollars, at the budget exchange rate of N1,409 to one dollar. He also sought approval for the funds to be raised through one or more of the identified sources, with greater emphasis on Eurobond issuance. Additionally, he requested authorisation for the Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economy, working with the Debt Management Office, to take necessary actions to implement the resolution. Reacting after reading the letter, the Senate President said the latest request superseded an earlier request for 20.3 billion dollars, describing the new correspondence as more explicit. Akpabio said the government would explore different funding sources to secure the most favourable borrowing terms through a willing-seller, willing-buyer arrangement. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.title_zh: 蒂努布寻求10.79万亿奈拉外部贷款，为2026年预算赤字融资
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/04/t.body_zh: 参议院收到总统博拉·蒂努布提出的请求，请求批准107.9万亿奈拉外债，约合77亿美元，用于填补2026年预算赤字的一部分。尼日利亚新闻社（NAN）报道，蒂努布的请求载于一封函件中，要求国民议会执行《2026年拨款法》批准的外部借款。参议院议长戈德斯维尔·阿克帕比奥在全体会议上宣读该函件时表示，这项请求依据《2003年债务管理办公室设立法》第21(1)条和第27(1)条提出。函件中，蒂努布回顾称，《2026年拨款法》规定安排292万亿奈拉新增借款，用于填补约314万亿奈拉的预算赤字。他解释，这笔借款包括184万亿奈拉国内借款和107.9万亿奈拉外部借款，后者正是此次请求所涉及的内容。据函件称，联邦政府计划通过一种或多种可用资金来源筹措约77亿美元。他表示，拟议资金来源包括多边和双边机构提供的优惠贷款及商业贷款、国际货币基金组织提供的贷款、过桥融资安排、直接向国际金融机构借款以及发行欧洲债券。总统表示，将同时考虑各种方案，并结合各自的成本、收益以及动用资金所需的时间进行比较。不过，他称会更加侧重发行欧洲债券，因为这种方式的落实通常更快，且能够以相对较低的成本筹集更大规模的资金。蒂努布解释，最终借款条款，包括利率和期限，将取决于定价时的市场状况。他保证，联邦财政部和债务管理办公室将努力为该国争取最优条款。总统表示，拟议借款将用于资助国防与安全、交通运输、农业、电力、教育和医疗等优先项目。他指出，这些资金将由尼日利亚中央银行代表联邦政府接收，同时也将用于支持外汇储备。因此，总统请求国民议会授权联邦政府实施107.9万亿奈拉、约合77亿美元的外部借款，预算汇率按1美元兑换1,409奈拉计算。他还请求批准通过一种或多种已确定的资金来源筹集这笔资金，并更加侧重发行欧洲债券。此外，他请求授权财政部长兼经济协调部长与债务管理办公室协作，采取必要行动落实该项决议。参议院议长在宣读函件后回应称，此次最新请求取代了此前请求筹措203亿美元的申请，并称新函件的表述更为明确。阿克帕比奥表示，政府将探索不同的资金来源，通过买卖双方自愿达成安排的方式，争取最有利的借款条款。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪谷路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办事处。该报是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过全平台为政界、商业界、专业人士和外交界精英以及更广泛的中产阶层服务，同时为有抱负者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术交汇的平台。这份报纸秉持公众信任， Dedicated 于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，直击人民与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.title: 2027: ADC urges Nigerians to replicate US voters’ revolt against ruling party
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.summary: ABUJA – The African Democratic Congress, ADC, has urged Nigerians to take a cue from American voters by using the 2027 general elections to reject the ruling All Progressives Congress, APC, over economic hardship, worsening insecurity and declining living standards. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.summary_zh: 阿布贾——非洲民主大会（ADC）敦促尼日利亚人效仿美国选民，在2027年大选中拒绝执政的进步大会党（APC），以回应经济困境、安全局势恶化和生活水平下降。该党表示，周二举行的美国中期选举证明，任何政府都不能把选民视为理所当然；并坚称，尼日利亚人在决定由谁治理国家时，必须把自身福祉置于政治忠诚、个人感情和人物政治之上。

The opposition party said Nigerians had endured years of economic hardship and worsening insecurity under the President Bola Tinubu-led APC administration, questioning why the ruling party should be rewarded with another mandate. “We cannot continue to complain about the cost of living while voting for a President who has made life unaffordable. Urging Nigerians to mobilise ahead of 2027, the party called for massive voter turnout, describing the Permanent Voter Card as an instrument for changing the country’s political direction. “History beckons in 2027. The party also unveiled its campaign message, presenting itself and its candidates as an alternative to the APC-led government. “The ADC and its candidates are offering Nigerians a clear alternative: Make Nigeria Affordable Again. Make Nigeria Safe Again. Give Nigerians Jobs Again,” the statement said. Drawing a direct parallel with the American elections, Abdullahi urged Nigerians to make their votes count in 2027, warning that the APC should not mistake its hold on power for a permanent mandate. “If Americans can use their votes to demand better, Nigerians can do the same. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body_zh: 阿布贾——非洲民主大会党（ADC）敦促尼日利亚人以美国选民为榜样，利用2027年大选否决执政的进步大会党（APC），原因是经济困境加剧、安全局势恶化以及生活水平下降。该党周二表示，美国中期选举证明，任何政府都不能把选民视为理所当然；尼日利亚人在决定由谁治理国家时，必须把自身福祉置于政治忠诚、情绪和人物政治之上。该党全国宣传秘书马利姆·博拉吉·阿卜杜拉希发表声明称，ADC将美国选举结果描述为对执政共和党领导层和经济政策的坚决斥责，并表示这为尼日利亚民主提供了重要教训。该党说：“美国人已经表明，当政客变得傲慢，当政策惩罚普通民众，当掌权者把受欢迎误认为永久执政许可时，投票箱仍然是问责的最终工具。”反对党表示，在博拉·蒂努布总统领导的APC政府执政期间，尼日利亚人忍受了多年的经济困境和不断恶化的安全局势，并质问为何还应以另一份授权奖励执政党。ADC说：“我们不能一边抱怨生活成本，一边投票给一位让生活变得难以承受的总统。我们不能一边要求安全，一边奖励失败。我们不能一边真诚渴望改变，一边维持导致我们共同贫困的政治制度。”该党敦促尼日利亚人为2027年大选动员起来，呼吁大批选民参与投票，并把永久选民卡称为改变国家政治方向的工具。阿卜杜拉希说：“历史正在2027年向我们招手。选民的投票卡必须成为变革的工具，而不是公民身份的纪念品。尼日利亚人必须大规模投出选票，为自身利益投票。”该党还公布了竞选口号，将自己和候选人定位为APC领导的政府之外的替代选择。声明说：“ADC及其候选人为尼日利亚人提供一个明确的替代选择：让尼日利亚再次负担得起，让尼日利亚再次安全，让尼日利亚人再次拥有就业。”阿卜杜拉希直接将尼日利亚大选中选民的投票选择与美国选举相联系，敦促尼日利亚人投出有意义的一票，并警告APC不应把其执政地位误认为永久授权。他说：“如果美国人可以投票要求更好的局面，尼日利亚人也可以做到。2027年，让我们用选票发出比APC造成的苦难更响亮的声音。”本文所表达的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://leadership.ng/us-midterm-electio.summary: The elections also produced the country’s first Black woman governor and additional milestones in gubernatorial representation, with candidates from both the Democratic and Republican parties making history. https://leadership.ng/us-midterm-electio.summary_zh: 此次选举还产生了该国首位黑人女性州长，并推动州长代表性取得更多突破，民主党和共和党的候选人均创造了历史。民主党人Abdul El-Sayed在密歇根州击败共和党人Mike Rogers，成为首位当选美国参议院的穆斯林。民主党人Chris Pappas赢得新罕布什尔州参议院选举后创造历史，成为首位当选美国参议院的公开同性恋男性。
https://leadership.ng/us-midterm-electio.body: The elections also produced the country’s first Black woman governor and additional milestones in gubernatorial representation, with candidates from both the Democratic and Republican parties making history. Democrat Abdul El-Sayed made history in Michigan after defeating Republican Mike Rogers to become the first Muslim elected to the United States Senate. His victory also prevented Republicans from flipping the seat previously held by retiring Democratic Senator Gary Peters, strengthening the Democratic Party’s position in the chamber. El-Sayed’s election represents a significant milestone for Muslim representation in American national politics, particularly in a country where no Muslim had previously served in the Senate. Democrat Peggy Flanagan secured a historic victory in Minnesota, becoming the first Native American woman elected to the United States Senate. Flanagan, who previously served two terms as Minnesota’s lieutenant governor, defeated Republican candidate Michele Tafoya, a former National Football League (NFL) sideline reporter and conservative podcaster. Her victory marks a major milestone for Indigenous representation in the upper chamber of Congress. Democrat Chris Pappas made history after winning the Senate race in New Hampshire, becoming the first openly gay man elected to the United States Senate. His victory marks another milestone for LGBTQ representation in American politics, expanding the diversity of voices represented in the country’s highest legislative chamber. At 29, Democrat Melat Kiros made history after winning the congressional race for Colorado’s 1st District. She becomes the first Generation Z woman elected to the US House of Representatives, marking a significant milestone for younger political representation. Her victory also highlights the growing presence of younger candidates in American electoral politics, as a new generation seeks greater representation in national decision-making. Democrat Keisha Bottoms made history after winning Georgia’s gubernatorial election, becoming the first Black woman elected governor in United States history. The former Atlanta mayor defeated Republican billionaire Rick Jackson to secure the landmark victory. Her election also makes her Georgia’s first Black governor, breaking a longstanding racial barrier in the state’s political leadership. Former US Interior Secretary Deb Haaland secured another historic victory after winning the New Mexico gubernatorial election. The Democrat becomes the first Native American woman elected governor in the United States, defeating Republican Gregg Hull, a former mayor. Haaland previously made history in 2021 when she became the first Native American to serve as US interior secretary under former President Joe Biden. Her gubernatorial victory further expands Indigenous representation in American political leadership. The gubernatorial elections also produced historic victories for Black candidates from both major political parties. Republican Byron Donalds won Florida’s gubernatorial election, becoming the state’s first Black governor. Meanwhile, Democrat David Crowley made history in Wisconsin after winning the governorship, becoming the state’s first Black governor. Their victories represent significant milestones for Black political representation, particularly as the United States has historically had very few Black governors. Maryland Governor Wes Moore, the country’s third elected Black governor and the only one serving at the time, also secured re-election, extending his place in American political history. https://leadership.ng/us-midterm-electio.body_zh: 此次选举还造就了该国首位黑人女性州长，并在州长代表性方面取得更多里程碑，民主党和共和党的候选人均创造了历史。民主党人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德在密歇根州击败共和党人迈克·罗杰斯，成为首位当选美国参议员的穆斯林，从而创造了历史。他的胜利还阻止共和党人拿下此前由即将退休的民主党参议员加里·彼得斯占据的席位，强化了民主党在参议院中的地位。埃尔-赛义德的当选是穆斯林在美国国家政治中代表性取得的重要里程碑，尤其是在此前从未有穆斯林担任参议员的国家。民主党人佩吉·弗拉纳根在明尼苏达州取得历史性胜利，成为首位当选美国参议员的美国原住民女性。弗拉纳根此前曾两度担任明尼苏达州副州长，她击败了共和党候选人米歇尔·塔福亚；塔福亚曾任美国国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）场边记者，也是一名保守派播客主持人。她的胜利标志着原住民在国会参议院代表性方面取得重大里程碑。民主党人克里斯·帕帕斯赢得新罕布什尔州参议院选举后创造了历史，成为首位公开同性恋身份且当选美国参议员的男性。他的胜利是 LGBTQ 群体在美国政治代表性方面的又一里程碑，拓宽了这个国家最高立法机构所代表声音的多样性。29岁的民主党人梅拉特·基罗斯赢得科罗拉多州第1选区国会议员选举后创造了历史，成为首位当选美国众议员的 Z 世代女性， marking 了年轻一代政治代表性的重要里程碑。她的胜利还凸显出年轻候选人在美国选举政治中日益增强的存在感，新一代正寻求在国家决策中获得更大代表性。民主党人基莎·博托姆斯赢得佐治亚州州长选举后创造了历史，成为美国历史上首位当选州长的黑人女性。这位前亚特兰大市长击败共和党亿万富翁里克·杰克逊，赢得了这场里程碑式的胜利。当选后，她也成为佐治亚州首位黑人州长，打破了该州政治领导层长期存在的种族壁垒。美国前内政部长黛布·哈兰赢得新墨西哥州州长选举后，再获历史性胜利。这位民主党人击败曾任市长的共和党人格雷格·赫尔，成为美国首位当选州长的美国原住民女性。哈兰此前已于2021年创造历史，她在前总统乔·拜登任内成为首位担任美国内政部长的美国原住民。她赢得州长选举，进一步扩大了原住民在美国政治领导层中的代表性。州长选举还为两大政党的黑人候选人带来了历史性胜利。共和党人拜伦·唐纳德赢得佛罗里达州州长选举，成为该州首位黑人州长。与此同时，民主党人大卫·克劳利赢得威斯康星州州长职位后创造了历史，成为该州首位黑人州长。他们的胜利是黑人政治代表性的重要里程碑，而美国历史上的黑人州长一直寥寥无几。马里兰州州长韦斯·穆尔是全美第三位经选举产生的黑人州长，也是当时唯一在任的黑人州长，他还成功连任，继续在美国政治史上留下自己的足迹。我们掌握领先优势。即时报道、独家内幕和独特视角将直接推送到你的手机上。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS 的 WhatsApp，随时随地获取全天候更新 →

https://leadership.ng/us-charges-2-niger.title: US Charges 2 Nigerians, 61 Other Nationals Over Alleged Illegal Voting
https://leadership.ng/us-charges-2-niger.summary: The 63 individuals are accused of various violations of federal election laws, with the charges announced on Monday as part of the administration’s ongoing efforts to prosecute alleged voter fraud. Agah, meanwhile, faces charges in the Western District of North Carolina for allegedly voting as a non-citizen and falsely claiming American citizenship to participate in an election.
https://leadership.ng/us-charges-2-niger.summary_zh: 这 63 人被控违反多项联邦选举法律，相关指控于周一公布，是本届政府持续起诉涉嫌选举舞弊行为的一部分。与此同时，Agah 在北卡罗来纳州西区面临指控，原因是其涉嫌以非公民身份投票，并虚假声称拥有美国公民身份以参加选举。
https://leadership.ng/us-charges-2-niger.body: The 63 individuals are accused of various violations of federal election laws, with the charges announced on Monday as part of the administration’s ongoing efforts to prosecute alleged voter fraud. The Nigerians named in the cases are Mohammed Omar Hassan, 61, and Michael Agah, 74, both of whom are lawful permanent residents of the United States. According to information published on the Justice Department’s website, Hassan was charged in the Southern District of Texas with voting in a federal election as a non-US citizen. Agah, meanwhile, faces charges in the Western District of North Carolina for allegedly voting as a non-citizen and falsely claiming American citizenship to participate in an election. The department alleged that Hassan voted in the 2022 and 2024 elections despite not being a US citizen. In Agah’s case, prosecutors accused him of falsely declaring himself an American citizen on an Authorization to Vote Form before casting his ballot in a federal election on November 5, 2024. The latest prosecutions come amid an intensified campaign against alleged election-related offences under President Donald Trump’s administration. US Attorney General Todd Blanche described the latest announcement as the biggest increase in voter-fraud arrests since Trump returned to the White House. “Today’s announcement marks the largest surge of voter-fraud arrests since President Trump returned to office,” Blanche said. “These foreign nationals allegedly took advantage of the trust of the American people and flouted the laws that govern our nation’s elections. This Department of Justice will continue investigating and prosecuting voter fraud to restore confidence in our electoral system,” he added. The Justice Department disclosed that it had charged 195 non-US citizens across 25 states with offences relating to illegal voting and voter registration within the preceding nine weeks. The figure brings the total number of individuals charged with voting fraud-related offences since the beginning of the Trump administration to 239, according to the department. The latest cases follow another round of prosecutions involving Nigerians and other foreign nationals announced less than two months earlier. On September 19, 2026, three Nigerians, Gladys Adaeze Okafor, 56; Helen Sayen Adams, 67; and Joshua Nmelichukwu Akpom, 27, were among those charged with alleged election-related offences. Okafor and Adams were accused of falsely claiming American citizenship to register and vote in elections, while Akpom faced allegations of making false statements in his application for naturalisation. The earlier cases involved allegations of unlawful voter registration, illegal voting, misrepresentation of citizenship status and other offences connected to the electoral process. The Justice Department said the latest prosecutions were filed in several federal judicial districts, including those in Texas, North Carolina, Tennessee, California, New Jersey and Pennsylvania. Other foreign nationals facing charges reportedly include citizens of Mexico, Jamaica, Canada, the Philippines, India, Colombia and the United Kingdom, among others. The department, however, emphasised that the charges contained in complaints, indictments and informations are allegations and do not constitute proof of guilt. All defendants are presumed innocent unless and until they are proven guilty beyond a reasonable doubt in court. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/us-charges-2-niger.title_zh: 美国起诉2名尼日利亚人及另外61名外国人，指其涉嫌非法投票
https://leadership.ng/us-charges-2-niger.body_zh: 这63人被告违反多项联邦选举法律。相关指控于周一公布，是本届政府持续起诉涉嫌选民欺诈行为的一部分。案件所列尼日利亚人为61岁的Mohammed Omar Hassan和74岁的Michael Agah，两人均为美国合法永久居民。根据司法部网站公布的信息，Hassan在得克萨斯州南区被控以非美国公民身份参加联邦选举投票。与此同时，Agah在北卡罗来纳州西区面临指控，罪名是涉嫌以非公民身份投票，并谎称拥有美国公民身份以参加选举。该部指控称，尽管不是美国公民，Hassan仍在2022年和2024年的选举中投了票。在Agah案中，检方指控他在2024年11月5日联邦选举投票前，于《投票授权表》上虚假声明自己是美国公民。最新起诉正值唐纳德·特朗普总统任内严厉打击涉嫌选举相关犯罪行动之际。美国司法部长Todd Blanche将最新公告描述为特朗普重返白宫以来选民欺诈逮捕人数增幅最大的一次。Blanche说：“今天的公告标志着特朗普总统就职以来选民欺诈逮捕人数出现最大增长。这些外国公民涉嫌利用美国人民的信任，藐视规范我国选举的法律。司法部将继续调查并起诉选民欺诈，以恢复公众对我国选举制度的信心。”他补充说。司法部披露，在此前9周内，该部已在25个州起诉195名非美国公民，罪名涉及非法投票和选民登记。据该部称，这一数字使特朗普政府开始执政以来因选民欺诈相关罪行而被起诉的人数累计达到239人。最新案件紧随此前不到两个月公布的一轮针对尼日利亚人及其他外国公民的起诉。2026年9月19日，3名尼日利亚人——56岁的Gladys Adaeze Okafor、67岁的Helen Sayen Adams和27岁的Joshua Nmelichukwu Akpom——被列入涉嫌选举相关罪行的人员之中。Okafor和Adams被控谎称拥有美国公民身份，以便登记选民并参加选举，而Akpom则被控在入籍申请中作出虚假陈述。此前案件涉及非法选民登记、非法投票、虚假陈述公民身份，以及其他与选举程序有关的罪行。司法部表示，最新起诉案提交至多个联邦司法区，包括得克萨斯州、北卡罗来纳州、田纳西州、加利福尼亚州、新泽西州和宾夕法尼亚州的司法区。据报道，其他面临指控的外国公民还包括墨西哥、牙买加、加拿大、菲律宾、印度、哥伦比亚和英国等国的公民。不过，该部强调，诉状、起诉书和刑事控告书中的指控均属指控，不构成有罪证明。除非在法庭上被证明有罪且达到排除合理怀疑的程度，否则所有被告均推定无罪。我们掌握领先优势。实时报道、突发独家新闻和独家视角将直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时获取全天候最新消息 →

https://leadership.ng/i-drove-taxi-to-fu.body: Tinubu said he had to postpone the commencement of his studies for several months to save enough money before eventually moving to Chicago, where he took up different jobs to support himself and pay his way through university. The President disclosed this in a statement reflecting on his administration’s education reforms, noting that his personal experiences had strengthened his belief that every Nigerian child deserves access to quality education, regardless of their family background or financial circumstances. “Those experiences have stayed with me. I know what education made possible in my own life, and I believe every Nigerian child deserves that same opportunity, regardless of where they are born or what their parents can afford,” he said. Tinubu described education as a major priority of his Renewed Hope administration, highlighting several interventions aimed at expanding access to learning and improving the quality of education across the country. He disclosed that the Nigerian Education Loan Fund (NELFUND) had provided over ₦372 billion in student loans for institutional fees and upkeep, helping young Nigerians remain in school and pursue their education. According to him, the government’s technical and vocational education programme has attracted over 2.8 million applications, while 38 technical colleges have been rehabilitated. He added that students in federal and selected state technical colleges now enjoy free school fees, boarding, textbooks and uniforms. On university education, the President said his administration had reached a new agreement with the Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU), providing for a 40 per cent increase in academic staff remuneration and measures to improve stability in the university system. He stressed the need for Nigerian universities to ensure students complete their programmes within the stipulated period. “A four-year course must take four years. Our young people deserve to complete their education on time and get on with their lives,” he said. Tinubu further disclosed that his administration was investing ₦110 billion in the rehabilitation of 24 medical schools as part of efforts to strengthen medical education in the country. He said annual nursing enrolment had increased from 28,000 to 115,000, while medical and dental enrolment had risen from 5,000 to 12,000. The President also revealed that over one million children who were previously out of school had been returned to learning. He listed teacher development, expanded educational opportunities for girls and the introduction of a new national curriculum that restores Nigerian History to classrooms among other interventions being implemented by his administration. Tinubu commended the Minister of Education, Dr Tunji Alausa, the Minister of State for Education, Professor Suwaiba Sa’id Ahmad, and the entire education team for their commitment to advancing reforms in the sector. He also urged Nigerians to visit edu4pbat.ng to explore the interactive A–Z of the Nigeria Education Sector Renewal Initiative (NESRI), which provides information on government programmes, reforms, achievements and opportunities in the education sector. The President encouraged parents, students and teachers to familiarise themselves with the available opportunities and provide feedback on challenges affecting education in their communities. He said the circumstances of a child’s birth should never determine the limits of their ambition, stressing that every Nigerian child deserves a fair opportunity to fulfil their potential. “We have more work to do, and I am determined to see it through,” he added. https://leadership.ng/us-midterm-republi.title: US Midterm: ‘Republicans Made A Choice And Followed Trump Over The Cliff’
https://leadership.ng/us-midterm-republi.summary: Schumer made the remarks during his victory speech after the Democratic Party reclaimed control of both chambers of Congress, declaring that Republicans had paid the price for their decision to align themselves with Trump and his policies. He accused the Republicans of following Trump despite the impact of his administration’s policies on the cost of electricity, healthcare and other essential goods.
https://leadership.ng/us-midterm-republi.summary_zh: Schumer是在民主党重新掌控国会两院后的胜选演讲中发表上述言论的。他宣称，共和党因决定与Trump及其政策站在一起而付出了代价。他指控共和党不顾特朗普政府政策对电费、医疗保健和其他基本商品成本造成的影响，一味追随特朗普。
https://leadership.ng/us-midterm-republi.body: Schumer made the remarks during his victory speech after the Democratic Party reclaimed control of both chambers of Congress, declaring that Republicans had paid the price for their decision to align themselves with Trump and his policies. He accused the Republicans of following Trump despite the impact of his administration’s policies on the cost of electricity, healthcare and other essential goods. “Then the Republicans embraced Trump, the worst president ever. Republicans made a choice and followed Trump over the cliff,” Schumer said. He argued that while Trump sometimes focused on what he described as irrelevant issues, his administration also implemented policies that increased the financial burden on American households. “Some of the time he talked about extraneous things that were ridiculous, but much of the time he implemented things that raised their costs on electricity, on health care, on goods,” he said. “Republicans had a choice of following Trump over the cliff, even though Trump policies made American families’ pain much worse. We never wavered. We listened to the American people, what they wanted,” he added. Schumer also credited Democratic candidates for their commitment to the party’s campaign, saying many of those recruited had other promising opportunities but chose to contest the elections because they believed their country needed them. “Every one of them that we recruited had great other opportunities, but they ran out of patriotism. They knew their country needed them. They knew in many cases, in every case, they were the best candidate for their state,” he said. The Democratic leader further said the party’s victory was driven by its decision to engage directly with voters, listen to their concerns and reflect their demands in its campaign. He said Democratic candidates visited voters in their homes, including their kitchens and living rooms, to understand the issues affecting them, accusing Republicans of failing to pay attention to the electorate. “We talked to them. We sat down in their kitchens, in their living rooms and said, ‘What should we do?’ And they told us and we listened. We listened, they didn’t,” Schumer said. Describing the outcome as a major political shift, he said Americans had dismantled the Republican electoral advantage, paving the way for a significant transformation of the Senate political landscape. “The American people reduced the red brick wall to a pile of bricks,” he said. Schumer added that the results had produced what he described as a generational remaking of the Senate electoral map, with implications for American politics both in the immediate future and for generations to come. He, however, acknowledged that the election victory came with expectations, urging Democrats to translate the confidence placed in them by voters into meaningful political and policy outcomes. “Americans voted for change and now Democrats must deliver,” he said. https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.title: Who are the Indian-origin candidates in U.S. midterm elections?
https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.summary: The Indian-origin candidates are contesting from States including California, Washington, Virginia, Arizona, Florida, Texas, Ohio, New York and Maryland. Here are some of the prominent Indian-origin candidates contesting the midterm elections: Congressman Khanna is a member of the progressive wing of the Democratic Party.
https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.summary_zh: 这些印度族裔候选人正在加利福尼亚州、华盛顿州、弗吉尼亚州、亚利桑那州、佛罗里达州、得克萨斯州、俄亥俄州、纽约州和马里兰州竞选。以下是参加中期选举的部分主要印度族裔候选人：众议员Khanna是民主党进步派阵营成员。
https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription All 435 seats in the House of Representatives are due for election, since members serve two-year terms. In the Senate, where members serve six years, 35 of the 100 seats are up for election, including special elections in Ohio and Florida. The Indian-origin candidates are contesting from States including California, Washington, Virginia, Arizona, Florida, Texas, Ohio, New York and Maryland. Their races span different levels of government, from the U.S. Congress and State executive offices to city leadership positions. Several Indian-Americans are in the fray across Texas, Florida, Arizona, Ohio, New York and Los Angeles. Democratic lawmakers Ro Khanna, Pramila Jayapal, Ami Bera and Suhas Subramanyam are seeking re-election to the U.S. Congress. Here are some of the prominent Indian-origin candidates contesting the midterm elections: Congressman Khanna is a member of the progressive wing of the Democratic Party. His grandfather, Amarnath Vidyalankar, was a freedom fighter who was imprisoned alongside Mahatma Gandhi and later served as a Congress Member of Parliament. Mr. Khanna is a second-generation immigrant. His father, a chemical engineer from the Indian Institute of Technology, and his mother, a school teacher, migrated to the United States from Punjab. Born in Philadelphia, Mr. Khanna studied economics at the University of Chicago before earning a law degree from Yale Law School. He later worked as an intellectual property lawyer with clients from the technology sector. A Democrat from California, Mr. Khanna is seeking re-election from California’s 17th Congressional District, which includes parts of Silicon Valley. He has criticised President Donald Trump’s policies as “utterly destructive”, described him as a “lame duck”, and said Democrats would prevail in the 2026 midterm elections and the 2028 presidential election. Congresswoman Jayapal, who was born in Chennai, is seeking another term from Washington’s 7th Congressional District. In 2020, she became the second Indian-American woman elected to the U.S. House of Representatives. Ms. Jayapal traces her roots to Kerala. Her mother, Maya Jayapal, is a writer and counsellor and the author of Bangalore: Roots and Beyond . Ms. Jayapal was the first Indian-American woman elected to the U.S. House of Representatives and has represented Washington’s 7th Congressional District since 2017. On October 14, 2026, Ms. Jayapal voiced concern over reports about the removal of 13 crore names from draft electoral rolls in India. The Democratic lawmaker said she supported non-violent protests against what she described as anti-democratic efforts. She said the developments appeared similar to attempts in the United States to undermine voting rights. India rejected her remarks on the Election Commission’s revision of electoral rolls , describing them as unwarranted, uninformed and an interference in the electoral practices of a fellow democracy. Dr. Bera, a physician and politician serving in the U.S. House of Representatives, is seeking re-election as the Democratic candidate from California’s 3rd Congressional District. The son of Gujarati immigrants from Rajkot, Dr. Bera was born in the United States. He was the third Indian-American elected to Congress. His father, Babulal Bera, later pleaded guilty to illegally funding his son’s election campaigns in 2010 and 2012. Also read | Congressman Ami Bera’s father guilty of election crime Dr. Bera has consistently advocated stronger India-U.S. ties. He served as co-chair of the Congressional Caucus on India and Indian Americans during the 114th Congress from January 2015 to January 2017. Congressman Subramanyam, who made history by becoming the first Indian-American elected to Congress from Virginia and the East Coast in 2024, is seeking re-election. Mr. Subramanyam’s parents moved to the United States through Dulles Airport in the late 1970s. His mother is from Bengaluru and his father from Chennai, though he also spent part of his childhood in Secunderabad because his father served in the military. Mr. Subramanyam has strongly supported closer India-U.S. ties, describing India as one of the world’s most important democracies and stressing the importance of strong relations between democratic nations. Republican Vivek Ramaswamy is running for Ohio Governor. Backed by President Donald Trump, Mr. Ramaswamy won the Republican primary in May and became the party’s nominee for the November election. A former co-chair of the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE), Mr. Ramaswamy launched a presidential campaign in 2024 before withdrawing and endorsing Mr. Trump. The son of immigrants from Kerala, Mr. Ramaswamy was born in Cincinnati, Ohio. His father, Vadakanchery Ganapathy Ramaswamy, worked as an engineer at General Electric, while his mother is a psychiatrist. Mr. Ramaswamy studied at Harvard University and Yale Law School before building a career in biotechnology and finance. He founded Roivant Sciences and served as its chief executive officer from 2014 to 2021. He later founded the asset management firm Strive. According to Forbes, his net worth is estimated at $2.5 billion. Republican Saritha Komatireddy, the party’s nominee for New York Attorney General, is a former federal prosecutor and a graduate of Harvard College and Harvard Law School. She spent more than a decade prosecuting members of Al Qaeda, ISIS and Mexican drug cartels. As a federal prosecutor in the Eastern District of New York, she handled several high-profile cases involving terrorism, cybercrime, narcotics trafficking, money laundering, fraud and foreign public corruption, according to her official campaign website . She later served in senior positions including Chief of International Narcotics and Money Laundering, Deputy Chief of Appeals and Deputy Chief of General Crimes in the district’s National Security and Cybercrime Section. She also served as Chief of Staff at the Drug Enforcement Administration and is currently a partner at Holtzman Vogel. Nithya Raman, an urban planner and member of the Los Angeles City Council representing District 4, is contesting the Los Angeles mayoral election, according to the City of Los Angeles official website. A graduate of Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Ms. Raman has served as co-chair of the Silver Lake Neighborhood Council’s Homelessness Committee and co-founded the SELAH Neighbourhood Homeless Coalition. She was elected to the City Council in 2020, becoming the first Asian-American woman and the first South Asian elected to the body. In March 2024, she won a second term. Ms. Raman currently chairs the Civil Rights, Immigration, Social Services and Neighbourhoods Committee and serves on several other council committees. Pooja Sethi is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 47. An attorney by profession, Ms. Sethi has served as chief of staff in the Texas Legislature and as chair of the Travis County Democratic Party, according to her Linkedin profile. Sandeep Srivastava is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 66. A long-time resident of the Plano-Frisco area, businessman and community advocate, Mr. Srivastava is challenging a five-term Republican incumbent in the November election, according to his official campaign website . Pia Dandiya, a former high school principal, is the Democratic candidate from Florida’s 22nd Congressional District and faces Republican Casey Askar. A first-generation American, Ms. Dandiya has built her campaign around education and affordability. Born and raised in Palm Beach County, she began her career as a teacher before becoming a high school principal in Harlem. She later founded a high school aimed at improving opportunities for low-income students. According to her campaign, every graduate of the school secured admission to college despite a large majority coming from low-income households. Amish Shah, a physician and former State Representative, is the Democratic candidate from Arizona’s 1st Congressional District. He is contesting against Republican candidate Jay Feely, a former National Football League kicker endorsed by President Donald Trump. Mr. Shah served three terms in the Arizona House of Representatives. He narrowly lost the 2024 congressional election to Republican David Schweikert. The Cook Political Report has classified Arizona’s 1st Congressional District as “Lean Democratic”, making the contest one of the closely watched races of the election cycle. https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.title_zh: 参加美国中期选举的印度裔候选人有哪些？
https://www.thehindu.com/news/internatio.body_zh:
订阅可享受高级新闻、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅全部内容即可解锁这些权益。

美国众议院全部435个席位都将迎来选举，因为议员任期为两年。参议院议员任期为六年，100个席位中有35个席位将进行改选，其中包括俄亥俄州和佛罗里达州的特别选举。

印度裔参选人来自加利福尼亚州、华盛顿州、弗吉尼亚州、亚利桑那州、佛罗里达州、得克萨斯州、俄亥俄州、纽约州和马里兰州等州。他们参加不同级别政府的选举，涵盖美国国会、州行政长官职位以及城市领导职位。多名印度裔美国人正在得克萨斯州、佛罗里达州、亚利桑那州、俄亥俄州、纽约州和洛杉矶角逐。

民主党议员Ro Khanna、Pramila Jayapal、Ami Bera和Suhas Subramanyam正在竞选连任美国国会议员。以下是参加中期选举的部分印度裔主要候选人：

众议员Khanna是民主党进步派成员。他的祖父Amarnath Vidyalankar是一名自由战士，曾与圣雄甘地一同入狱，后来担任国会议员。Khanna先生是第二代移民。他的父亲是毕业于印度理工学院的化学工程师，母亲是一名学校教师，二人在20世纪70年代从旁遮普邦移居美国。Khanna先生出生于费城，在芝加哥大学学习经济学，之后获得耶鲁大学法学院法学学位。他后来担任知识产权律师，为科技行业的客户提供服务。作为来自加利福尼亚州的民主党人，Khanna先生正竞选连任加利福尼亚州第17国会选区，该选区包括硅谷的部分地区。他批评总统唐纳德·特朗普的政策“具有彻底的破坏性”，称他是“跛脚鸭”，并表示民主党将在2026年中期选举和2028年总统选举中获胜。

众议员Jayapal出生于金奈，正竞选连任华盛顿州第7国会选区议员。2020年，她成为第二位当选美国众议员的印度裔美国女性。Jayapal女士的祖籍在喀拉拉邦。她的母亲Maya Jayapal是一名作家和咨询师，也是《Bangalore: Roots and Beyond》的作者。Jayapal女士是首位当选美国众议员的印度裔美国女性，自2017年以来一直代表华盛顿州第7国会选区。2026年10月14日，Jayapal女士对有关印度选民名册草案中删除1300万个名字的报道表示担忧。这位民主党议员说，她支持针对她所称反民主企图的非暴力抗议。她表示，这些 developments 看起来类似于美国破坏投票权利的企图。印度驳斥了她的言论，称选举委员会修订选民名册的做法毫无根据、缺乏依据，而且干涉了一个民主国家的选举事务。

Bera博士是一名医生和政治家，现任美国众议员，正以民主党候选人身份竞选连任加利福尼亚州第3国会选区议员。Bera博士是来自拉杰科特的古吉拉特移民之子，出生于美国。他是第三位当选国会议员的印度裔美国人。他的父亲Babulal Bera后来承认 illegally 为儿子的2010年和2012年竞选活动提供资金。另请阅读｜众议员Ami Bera的父亲承认犯有选举犯罪

Bera博士始终主张加强印美关系。2015年1月至2017年1月，他在第114届国会担任“国会印度与印度裔美国人核心小组”联合主席。

众议员Subramanyam于2024年创造历史，成为首位从弗吉尼亚州以及美国东海岸当选国会议员的印度裔美国人，目前正竞选连任。20世纪70年代末，Subramanyam的父母经杜勒斯机场移居美国。他的母亲来自班加罗尔，父亲来自金奈；由于父亲曾在军队服役，他也曾在塞康德拉巴德度过部分童年时光。Subramanyam先生坚决支持加强印美关系，称印度是世界上最重要的民主国家之一，并强调民主国家之间建立牢固关系的重要性。

共和党人Vivek Ramaswamy正在竞选俄亥俄州州长。在总统唐纳德·特朗普的支持下，Ramaswamy先生于5月赢得共和党初选，成为该党11月大选的候选人。他曾任政府效率部（DOGE）联合主席，2024年启动总统竞选，之后退出并支持特朗普先生。Ramaswamy先生是来自喀拉拉邦的移民之子，出生于俄亥俄州辛辛那提。他的父亲Vadakanchery Ganapathy Ramaswamy曾是通用电气的工程师，母亲是一名精神科医生。Ramaswamy先生先后就读哈佛大学和耶鲁大学法学院，随后在生物技术和金融领域发展事业。他创办了Roivant Sciences，并于2014年至2021年担任该公司首席执行官。后来，他创办了资产管理公司Strive。据《福布斯》估计，他的净资产为25亿美元。

共和党人Saritha Komatireddy是该党纽约州总检察长候选人，曾任联邦检察官，毕业于哈佛学院和哈佛大学法学院。她从事起诉基地组织、ISIS和墨西哥毒品-cartel成员的工作十余年。据其官方竞选网站，她在纽约州东区担任联邦检察官期间，审理了多起备受关注的案件，涉及恐怖主义、网络犯罪、贩毒、洗钱、欺诈和外国公职人员腐败问题。她后来在多个高级职位任职，包括国际毒品与洗钱事务主管、上诉副主管，以及该区国家安全和网络犯罪部门一般犯罪副主管。她还曾任美国缉毒署幕僚长，目前是Holtzman Vogel的合伙人。

据洛杉矶市政府官方网站，城市规划师、洛杉矶市议会第4选区议员Nithya Raman正在参加洛杉矶市长选举。Raman女士毕业于哈佛大学和麻省理工学院，曾任银湖社区委员会无家可归者问题委员会联合主席，并共同创办SELAH社区无家可归者联盟。她于2020年当选市议员，成为该机构首位亚裔美国女性和首位南亚裔议员。2024年3月，她赢得第二个任期。Raman女士目前担任民权、移民、社会服务与社区委员会主席，并在多个其他市议会委员会任职。

Pooja Sethi是得克萨斯州众议院第47选区的民主党候选人。据其LinkedIn个人资料，Sethi女士是一名律师，曾任得克萨斯州议会幕僚长和特拉维斯县民主党主席。

Sandeep Srivastava是得克萨斯州众议院第66选区的民主党候选人。据其官方竞选网站，长期居住在普莱诺—弗里斯科地区的企业家和社区倡导者Srivastava先生，将在11月大选中挑战已连任五届的共和党议员。

Pia Dandiya曾任高中校长，是佛罗里达州第22国会选区的民主党候选人，将对阵共和党人Casey Askar。作为第一代美国人，Dandiya女士围绕教育和生活成本问题开展竞选。她出生并成长于棕榈滩县，最初从教师职业起步，后来担任哈莱姆一所高中校长。她后来创办了一所致力于为低收入学生创造更多机会的高中。据其竞选团队介绍，尽管大多数学生来自低收入家庭，但该校每名毕业生都获得了大学录取资格。

Amish Shah是一名医生和前州议员，是亚利桑那州第1国会选区的民主党候选人。他将与共和党候选人Jay Feely竞争，后者曾担任美国国家橄榄球联盟踢球手，并获得总统唐纳德·特朗普支持。Shah先生曾在亚利桑那州众议院任职三届。他在2024年国会选举中以微弱差距败给共和党人David Schweikert。《库克政治报告》将亚利桑那州第1国会选区列为“倾向民主党”，使这场竞选成为本届选举周期备受关注的选区之一。
